1.title: GE - We Are the Wave [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E06 - It's the Only Way

1.plot: In the series premiere of this medical drama set in a 1900s New York City hospital, accomplished Dr. John W. Thackery is named chief surgeon and is pressured by a major benefactor to hire a black doctor as his top assistant.

1.title: FR - The Knick - S01E02 - Mr. Paris Shoes
1.plot: Already fuming over the hospital's faulty new electrical system, Thackery tasks Herman Barrow, the Knick's crooked superintendent, to deliver more cadavers so that he and his team can test out novel surgical procedures. With more patients dying, Edwards offers to share a procedure he learned in France, but is rebuffed by Thackery and Gallinger. Robertson addresses a typhoid-fever outbreak, Elkins is taken into Thackery's confidence and Sister Harriet breaks a taboo. Edwards finds an alternative way to perform his duties.

Meanwhile, Bertie receives a scolding from his physician father who is unhappy with his son's career path and Lucy becomes privy to Thackery's secrets.

1.title: FR - The Knick - S01E05 - They Capture the Heat
1.plot: Barrow can alleviate a debt if he treats one of Collier's wounded men and also urges Capt. Robertson to buy one of Thomas Edison's new inventions. Meanwhile, Algernon tries a new approach to hernia surgery, the health of Everett and Eleanor's baby worsens, and Sister Harriet and Cleary head to Chinatown.

1.title: FR - The Knick - S01E06 - Start Calling Me Dad

Euphoric after helping Speight, Cornelia finds herself less than enthusiastic about her status as the future Mrs. Phillip Showalter. Thackery entertains a salesman’s pitch; Everett considers how to help Eleanor with her grief; Barrow haggles over used merchandise. Edwards finds his clinic, and his career, in jeopardy after a surprise encounter.

1.title: FR - The Knick - S01E07 - Get the Rope
1.plot: The stabbing of a cop by a black man stirs up racial tension on the street and in the Knick, forcing Thackery and Edwards to take action. Everett returns to work and a changed OR. Barrow fears for Junia’s safety. Cornelia is impressed with Edwards’ ingenuity and Lucy is escorted home.

Bertie continues his courtship of Lucy while staving off his father’s persistent demands that he leave the Knick. Cornelia, Speight and Bertie go to court in an attempt to keep “Typhoid Mary” Mallon quarantined. Gallinger tries to get Eleanor to move past her grief.

Gallinger despairs as Eleanor’s behavior becomes more erratic; Cornelia and Edwards proffer different solutions to a shared dilemma.

Cornelia and Edwards arrive at a crossroads; Barrow trades one creditor for another; Lucy requests Bertie’s help. With the Knick in the midst of yet another crisis, Robertson calls for a vote.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E01 - Ten Knots
2.plot: The hospital readies for its move uptown, while Dr. Edwards makes a play to be named permanent chief of surgery and Dr. Gallinger heads over to Cromartie Hospital in hopes of getting Dr. Thackery to come back to work. Bertie rebuffs Lucy's attempt to make amends. Ping Wu demands his prostitutes be given regular medical checkups. Speight tracks a new plague. Cornelia ministers to a quarantined San Francisco neighborhood.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E02 - You're No Rose
2.plot: Dr. Thackery makes a move to return to The Knick, which the board frowns upon. Cornelia gets Cleary to do a dirty job, but it comes with a cost. Robertson makes a push for a new subway initiative. Barrow drives up construction costs. Lucy receives a surprise visitor from home.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E03 - The Best with the Best to Get the Best
2.plot: Thackery enlists Edwards to help him test a new hypothesis. After rejecting Robertson’s advances at The Knick, Lucy learns that confession isn’t always good for the soul. Young journalist Genevieve Everidge works on a story about one of Thackery’s rivals. Cornelia is dismayed by the limits of her husband’s sympathies. Barrow faces a new adversary at Tammany Hall. Gallinger is intrigued by a discussion of eugenics at a class reunion. Edwards deals with a surprise visitor.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E04 - Wonderful Surprises
2.plot: Abby’s worsening condition persuades Thackery to test out his novel syphilis treatment. Edwards comes clean to Opal, but does not get the response he expects. Cleary makes a last-ditch effort to raise funds for Harriet as her date in court arrives. Bertie undergoes physical training. Barrow loses a sponsor. Gallinger’s prejudices are reinforced. Cornelia probes a suspicious death. Lucy laments her lot in life.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E05 - Whiplash
2.plot: A subway explosion leads to an influx of patients at The Knick, but little margin for profit. Pursued by Henry, Lucy takes to heart advice from one of Ping Wu’s girls. An addict’s misfortune gives Thackery an ideal test case for his latest theory on addiction. Bertie submits his adrenalin research to Zinberg. Cornelia gets a new clue in Speight’s death. Barrow repays a debt but gets no credit. Genevieve charms the Chickerings. Harriet finds herself a boarding-house pariah.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E06 - There Are Rules
2.plot: Faced with a quandary, Bertie decides to take matters into his own hands at Mt. Sinai, enlisting Algernon to help. Thackery investigates the efficacy of hypnosis, and takes an interest in a pair of conjoined twins. Lucy lobbies Henry for a gala invitation. Cornelia visits the brother of a deceased immigrant with ties to Speight. Gallinger dines with an unwelcome guest. Barrow previews a new home for Junia. Harriet agrees to make a change.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E07 - Williams and Walker
2.plot: Fighting his nerves, Thackery readies himself to attempt to separate Zoya and Nika in front of a packed audience. After getting a surprise gift from her father-in-law, Cornelia attends a gala charity ball for the new Knick with other familiar guests. Barrow gets rid of a threat. Opal spoils the Robertsons’ good mood. Algernon gets a long-overdue spotlight in the surgical theater, but complications ensue.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E08 - Not Well At All
2.plot: Thackery attempts a new cure in the inebriation ward; Brockhurst demands his "girls" be returned; Gallinger and his wife's relationship and Bertie's relationship with Genevieve go off in surprising directions. Later, Cornelia shows evidence of the company's wrongdoing to Henry; Barrow's marriage troubles come to a head; and Thackery performs plastic surgery on Abby.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E09 - Do You Remember Moon Flower?
2.plot: Thackery and Capt. Robertson's connection and how the doctor arrived at the Knick, are revealed; the problems between Edwards and Gallinger come to a head after a medical-board hearing about Gallinger's vasectomies. Later, Cleary and Harriet engage in a joint business venture; Lucy shares memories with her father; Barrow realizes the rising costs of living well; and Cornelia and Henry face a family crisis.

2.title: FR - The Knick - S02E10 - This Is All We Are
2.plot: Thackery ignores Zinberg's advice at Mt. Sinai and undertakes a risky, alternative course of action; Cornelia confronts Henry about the family business; Barrow's actions at the hospital construction site are called into question; Gallinger ponders a job opportunity; and Cleary steadfastly refuses to give up on Harriet.

meta.plot: Set in downtown New York in 1900, 'The Knick' is centered on the Knickerbocker Hospital and its staff, notably Dr. John Thackery, the hospital's brilliant chief surgeon who pushes medicine's boundaries, pioneering new procedures despite a severe drug addiction.
Set during the final days of slavery in 19th century Jamaica, we follow the trials, tribulations and survival of plantation slave July and her odious mistress Caroline.

1.title: FR - The Long Song - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Born a slave, July is taken from her mother to a plantation house and forced to work for the odious Caroline. But she slowly learns how to handle her new mistress.

1.title: FR - The Long Song - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Caroline and July compete for Robert's attention. Robert announces he is marrying Caroline, but on the wedding night he goes to July's bed.

1.title: FR - The Long Song - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Angry and frustrated by the workers' refusal to work to his orders, Robert takes violent revenge, hoping to scare them into working - to the shock and horror of July.

meta.plot: Brilliant young actress Charlie strikes up an acquaintance with an intriguing stranger while on holiday in Greece, but it rapidly becomes apparent that his intentions are far from romantic.

1.title: FR - The Little Drummer Girl - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Charlie, a fiery and brilliant young actress, meets a mysterious stranger on the beach in Greece, and he draws her into an international espionage operation.

1.title: FR - The Little Drummer Girl - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Charlie is recruited with the promise of the role of a lifetime to infiltrate a dangerous revolutionary cell. As a cover story, she and Becker must pose as lovers.

1.title: FR - The Little Drummer Girl - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Charlie drives a car laden with explosives to a drop-off in Austria, while Kurtz and Becker race to save her from a fatal mistake.

1.title: FR - The Little Drummer Girl - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: In London, Kurtz's team prepare for the next stage of the operation as Charlie waits and wonders if Michel's people will make contact.

1.title: FR - The Little Drummer Girl - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Charlie joins a group of revolutionaries in Lebanon, with no one to save her if she is exposed as a spy. She works to earn the trust of Khalil and Michel's sister, Fatmeh.

1.title: FR - The Little Drummer Girl - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Charlie prepares for her part in Khalil's next strike. But is she still playing a role, or has she switched to the other side?

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: L.A. district attorney Maya Travis suffers a devastating defeat after prosecuting an A-list movie star for double murder. With her high-profile career derailed, she flees for a quieter life in rural Washington. Eight years later, when this same star is under suspicion for another murder, Maya is lured back to the DA’s office for another chance at justice.

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E02 - Revenge
1.plot: Maya and Matthew search Sevvy's house for anything that might lead to an arrest as they face mounting pressure from Wiest to build a case quickly; Ezra tries to clean up Sevvy's image.

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E03 - The Wire
1.plot: Maya convinces an asset to wear a wire during a rendezvous with Sevvy; Ezra works to create an alibi for Sevvy and he sends his henchman, Buck, to pay a visit to Riv at his ranch.

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E04 - Scandal
1.plot: Maya obtains surveillance footage of Jessica and Julianne the night before Jessica's death. Elsewhere, Maya finds out that there's a mole leaking information to Ezra.

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E05 - Lie to Me
1.plot: With the discovery of a mole in the office, the entire building is put on lockdown. Elsewhere, Ezra works to cover up Sevvy's injuries and keep the information contained.

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E06 - The Fugitive
1.plot: Maya and Sevvy face off in court once again. Meanwhile, Wiest believes that there is information about the mole hunt that Matthew isn't telling him.

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E07 - Ghost Whisperer
1.plot: Demoted to second chair, Ezra plots to bring down Angela but when Loni plants the seed about a past case being investigated, Ezra focuses his attention to Maya.

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E08 - Queen for a Day
1.plot: Maya and the team are determined to keep evidence from imploding their case. Elsewhere, Ezra and Angela are thrown when Sevvy goes off-book, offering up a massive reward for information about Jessica's murder.

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E09 - Jeopardy
1.plot: CJ has a plan to capture Maya's stalker. Elsewhere, Ezra and Sevvy follow a tip to Vegas and uncover Jessica's secret trip to a gun range.

1.title: FR - The Fix - S01E10 - Making a Murderer
1.plot: Maya and Ezra work together as Sevvy's case comes to a head. Sevvy makes a rash decision after he receives a mysterious letter from a law firm.

meta.plot: High-profile district attorney Maya Travis fled L.A. after devastating defeat when prosecuting an A-list actor for double murder. Eight years later, the same celebrity is under suspicion for another murder, and Maya is lured back to the DA’s office for another chance at justice.
Three fiercely talented female homicide investigators work tirelessly to solve crimes while navigating the complicated demands of their personal lives.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E01 - Wake Up Call
1.plot: Reeling from a shocking revelation in her personal life, Detective Jack Cooper throws herself into the investigation of an apparent suicide with her partner Detective Stevie Hall.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E02 - The Past Is Never Dead
1.plot: After a young computer programmer is found brutally murdered, Homicide Detectives Stevie Hall and Jack Cooper find themselves on a twisting road through his fatal last days, while still managing their own spiralling personal lives.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E03 - The Devil and the Deep Blue Sea
1.plot: Det. Jack Cooper joins Staff Inspector Fiona Currie on an assignment where they advise on a murder case that resembles an infamous crime Fiona solved years ago. Detectives Stevie Hall and Kyle Price track a lead in the redhead case.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E04 - Secret Liars
1.plot: After a young girl is found dead in the trunk of a car, Detectives Stevie Hall and Jack Cooper counsel the girl's shattered family through their grief while hunting down the killer before they can strike again.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E05 - The Long Walk
1.plot: A significant case for Det. Stevie Hall and Det. Jack Cooper of a man charged with multiple rapes and murder is undermined when his attorney turns out to be Jack's vindictive ex, Marc Savage.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E06 - When One Door Closes
1.plot: When the body of Brooke Dodson washes ashore, the hunt for her killer goes into overdrive, as the homicide detectives find themselves in a deadly cat and mouse game.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E07 - Bad Traffic
1.plot: Detectives Stevie Hall and Jack Cooper are called to the scene of a murder that's taken place overnight at a drug-filled party of bike couriers.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E08 - A Junkie's Broken Promise
1.plot: After a man is found burned beyond recognition with a dog collar around his neck, Staff Inspector Fiona Currie reaches out to the public for help identifying him, leading Detectives Stevie Hall and Jack Cooper down a path towards a trio of suspects.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E09 - It Takes a Village
1.plot: Hall, Cooper and Currie investigate a case after a woman wakes up with a gun in her hand and her husband shot-dead in front of her.

1.title: FR - The Detail - S01E10 - Off the Path
1.plot: After Detective Hall goes missing, the team race against the clock to save her life.

meta.plot: 1933. Hercule Poirot, older and greyer, receives letters threatening murder. The sender signs themselves only as “A.B.C.” When he takes the letters to the police looking for help, Hercule finds all his old friends have moved on. But soon there is a murder and the once-great detective must take matters into his own hands.

1.title: FR - ABC contre Poirot - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: It's 1933, and an older and greyer Hercule Poirot receives letters threatening murder. When no-one listens to his appeals, the once great detective must take matters into his own hands.

1.title: FR - ABC contre Poirot - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The ABC killer sends more letters promising to spill blood. Hercule's past, integrity and identity come into question while he fights a rising tide of xenophobia.

1.title: FR - ABC contre Poirot - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: With the ABC killer still on the loose, Hercule realises that only he holds the key to the murders. He faces a race against time to stop the bloodbath.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E01 - Day 1: Fade In
1.plot: Jane Sadler is an overworked television producer and single mother in the middle of a fractious separation. When her young daughter goes missing in the middle of the night, Jane’s world – and her controversial police TV show – implodes. Life imitates art: everything is a mystery, everyone has a secret and no one can be trusted.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E02 - Day 2: Cutting Room Floor
1.plot: After seeing the security-camera footage of PJ staking out her house the night that Lake went missing, Jane goes on a desperate search to find PJ and question him. Meanwhile, Bird learns the truth about Lake’s nanny; plus Pete, Ali and Tom canvas the neighborhood trying to find Lake.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E03 - Day 3: Day Out of Days
1.plot: A breakthrough in the investigation sends Detective Bird and Jane to the studio to question the production team on her hit show. Meanwhile, Pete goes on the attack in a rash display of anguish – or guilt.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E04 - Day 4: Below the Line
1.plot: Jane’s belief that Pete took Lake leads her down a dark path, putting both of them in danger. Meanwhile, Bird digs further into Lake’s disappearance and begins to unravel Jane’s lies.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E05 - Day 5: Back To Ones
1.plot: As the investigation continues and Jane’s suspicions grow, she’s more determined than ever to do anything to get her daughter back, including changing every detail of her show’s series finale. Meanwhile, a guilt-stricken Pete inadvertently pushes Tom toward writing a career-making story.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E06 - Day 6: Down Day
1.plot: Jane and Ali get a surprise phone call about who has Lake, but when the call is abruptly cut short, Jane has no way of tracing the call without going to the police.  However, the only cop she is willing to trust is Gus, so she needs to find him – fast.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E07 - Day 7: Breaking The Story
1.plot: Jane and Bird catch a break in the case when they revisit the scene of the Casita raid that started it all. Meanwhile, Ali learns some surprising news about Tom; and Jane discovers a shocking development about Gus.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E08 - Day 8: Against Type
1.plot: Jane’s search for Lake reaches a climax. Meanwhile, Ali finds herself in an unexpected situation with PJ, Jane’s drug dealer.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E09 - Day 9: Recast
1.plot: Jane flees town for her own protection while Bird continues to work the case. Meanwhile, Ali tries to keep the peace with Pete; and Red’s identity is revealed.

1.title: FR - Ten Days in the Valley - S01E10 - Day 10: Fade Out
1.plot: In the Season 1 finale, Jane finds herself in immediate danger when the kidnapper’s identity is discovered. Bird’s investigation connects him to new evidence that leads to a shocking confrontation. Meanwhile, Ali reveals a secret to Pete; and Tom has to make a choice between family and his career.

meta.plot: Single mother Jane Sadler's life is turned upside down when her young daughter goes missing in the middle of the night. And just like in the controversial police TV show she produces, everything is a mystery, everyone has a secret and no one can be trusted.

After Neurosurgeon Maggie Sullivan’s personal and professional life are thrown into turmoil she returns home to Sullivan’s Crossing. While there, Maggie is forced to navigate her complicated present while confronting the painful past she has chosen to ignore for years.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E01 - Coming Home
1.plot: When neurosurgeon Maggie Sullivan's seemingly perfect life in Boston is turned upside down, she leaves the city and her boyfriend, Andrew, to return to her childhood home of Sullivan's Crossing in Nova Scotia.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E02 - Homewrecker
1.plot: Maggie sees Cal in a new light after they help an injured resident and spend time together at karaoke.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E03 - Detours
1.plot: Sydney attempts to cheer up Maggie after she suffers a setback back at home. Frank and Edna help Sully, with the annual land blessing, but the festivities end early after a camper goes missing. Maggie and Cal work together with the search and rescue team unaware that another life hangs in the balance.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E04 - Rock and a Hard Place
1.plot: Maggie and Cal work against the clock in a daring medical rescue, and in the process discover a clue to the whereabouts of a missing camper. Maggie learns a little more about Cal’s past, while Sully receives disturbing news.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E05 - Pressure Drop
1.plot: Maggie makes a difficult decision after Sully lets his temper get the best of him.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E06 - Boiling Point
1.plot: Sully tries to hold things together at Sullivan's Crossing, while Maggie attempts to navigate complications back in Boston, Mass.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E07 - Second Chances
1.plot: Tensions escalate as Maggie returns to Sullivan's Crossing with Andrew.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E08 - Aftershock
1.plot: Maggie struggles to make sense of her personal life. Sully deals with some financial challenges.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E09 - Can't Help Falling
1.plot: Maggie's medical training is put to the test as she races against the clock to save the life of a friend.

1.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S01E10 - Sins of the Father
1.plot: Maggie returns to Boston prepared to face the consequences of her actions, while Cal searches for closure of his own.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E01 - Guilt Trip
2.plot: Maggie Sullivan returns to the Crossing to find Sully in the hospital, struggling with the feeling that he's forgotten something; Cal Jones is confused when Maggie gives him the cold shoulder, unaware that Lola pocketed his goodbye letter.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E02 - A Storm Is Brewing
2.plot: Maggie searches for clues regarding the cause of Sully's condition as she struggles to make a decision about her own future.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E03 - Confessions
2.plot: Maggie, Cal, Lola, and Sydney help Edna prepare the campground for a storm as Frank helps Sully to figure out what's been eating at him.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E04 - Eye of the Storm
2.plot: Things start to heat up between Maggie and Cal when they're forced to take shelter at Cal's cabin.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E05 - Secrets
2.plot: Uncertain about her own future as well as that of the Crossing, Maggie tries to find a way to help Sully.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E06 - Revelations
2.plot: Maggie's world is turned upside down after she learns some devastating news about her stepfather.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E07 - Reunions
2.plot: Reeling over the news of Maggie's pregnancy, Cal receives a visitor; Phoebe and Sully start to bond over the idea of being grandparents.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E08 - Truth and Consequences
2.plot: Maggie helps care for Cal's sister and in the process learns more about his past.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E09 - Remorse
2.plot: Maggie enlists Cal’s help when Sully becomes convinced he needs to take drastic measures to make amends with Lola.

2.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S02E10 - It's a Wonderful Life
2.plot: Cal works with Maggie as she fights to save the Crossing, while a careless mistake may cost someone their life.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E01 - New Beginnings
3.plot: Maggie tries to embrace her new life at the Crossing as she struggles to move past the loss she suffered the night of the diner fire.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E02 - Out of the Blue
3.plot: Maggie and Cal's relationship starts to heat up; Sully realizes he has some things in common with Helen.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E03 - The Ties That Bind
3.plot: Maggie accompanies Cal to visit his parents; Sully and Frank get to the bottom of who's behind the new development.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E04 - A Clear Perspective
3.plot: Maggie tries to help Cal deal with his conflicted feelings towards his father; Sully worries about how he will compete with the new development.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E05 - Misunderstandings
3.plot: Maggie grows concerned about Cal after he makes a series of rash decisions, while an unexpected visitor threatens Sully and Rob's plans for the diner.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E06 - Bad Timing
3.plot: Everyone at the Crossing pitches in to try and help Rob save his new restaurant while Maggie and Cal continue to drift apart.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E07 - Twists and Turns
3.plot: Everyone at the Crossing bands together to look for Lola and Jacob when it comes to light that the two never made it home from the woods.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E08 - Blindsided
3.plot: As Glenn's condition deteriorates, Maggie thinks there may be a connection to a firefighter who collapsed during renovations at the lodge.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E09 - First Cut is the Deepest
3.plot: Maggie faces a difficult decision after a loved one becomes ill.

3.title: FR - Sullivan's Crossing - S03E10 - Head to the Heart
3.plot: Cal believes that Maggie's missing her career, while relationships come to a head at the opening of Rob's restaurant.

meta.plot: Despite the Philippine government's crackdown on narcotics, high schooler Joseph expands his drug running while his cop uncle profits from corruption.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Runner
1.plot: After receiving a text message, high school student Joseph sneaks out of class to take care of some risky business in a local neighborhood.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Officer
1.plot: When Joseph's name appears on a suspects list kept by the police as part of a government crackdown on drug offenders, his Uncle Camilo takes action.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Traitor
1.plot: When Joseph spots a fellow gang member in suspicious company, he secretly follows him and witnesses a horrifying betrayal.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Execution
1.plot: In the middle of the night, Joseph sneaks out of his family's home to join his gang in seeking revenge against the traitor in their midst.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Cheater
1.plot: While visiting his sister in Manila, Joseph has another run-in with the law. His brother-in-law pulls some strings but makes his wife suspicious.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Drug
1.plot: As the extent of his double life unfolds, brother-in-law Bino introduces Joseph to the world of high-end party drugs.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Party
1.plot: Joseph enjoys his increased income, but the glamour of his new job is soon tarnished by a TV news report and an undercover operation.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Operation
1.plot: Bino tries to help Joseph and gang mate Tisoy cover their tracks. But the police are hot on their heels and determined to catch them, dead or alive.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Asset
1.plot: Police officer Rod joins colleague Camilo on a mission to capture a Japanese drug lord, using sex worker Christina as their undercover asset.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Kidnap
1.plot: With Christina's help, Rod and Camilo raid Takeo's home and make an arrest. But it soon becomes apparent that this is no ordinary police capture.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Cover-up
1.plot: When the press start asking questions about an alleged kidnapping of a Japanese national, Camilo and Rod are ordered to cover their tracks.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Whistleblower
1.plot: Rod gets greedy and insists on going after the additional money they were promised, unaware Takeo's wife is working with a different police unit.

1.title: PH - Amo [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Escape
1.plot: Camilo goes into hiding and calls his boss, begging for help. Meanwhile, a witness comes forward and spills details of the kidnapping on a radio show.

meta.plot: When a head chef falls into a coma, it's up to his devoted sous-chef to keep their Filipino fine dining restaurant from closing down.

1.title: PH - Replacing Chef Chico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Lovestruck sous-chef Ella tries to help save the restaurant where she works — until devastating news threatens everything.

1.title: PH - Replacing Chef Chico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Ella's shift starts in disaster as she clashes with the charismatic new consultant Raymond and serves an unusually critical VIP.

1.title: PH - Replacing Chef Chico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Two orders of adobo spark a competition between Ella and veteran chef Carlon, while all the staffers place bets behind their backs.

1.title: PH - Replacing Chef Chico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: After running into Chico's fiancee at the hospital, a downcast Ella tries to focus on her first day as head chef at Hain — only to face a power outage.

1.title: PH - Replacing Chef Chico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Things look bleak for Hain, but a risky gamble could turn things around. Ella has an emotional talk with Raymond. An unexpected visitor shocks the staff.

1.title: PH - Replacing Chef Chico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Tensions run high in the kitchen as an influencer couple and a covert food critic arrive. Ella considers her options as Raymond reveals his plans.

1.title: PH - Replacing Chef Chico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: A couple get married at the restaurant, forcing Carlon into an awkward position. Ella's turn as head chef receives a glowing review online.

1.title: PH - Replacing Chef Chico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Raymond and Chico give Ella dueling proposals: to start a restaurant in Singapore or continue fighting for Hain's survival.

meta.plot: Welcome to a food extravaganza, a visual poem to Mexico's foodie ingenuity and the quirky and delicious flavors that are worth the stomach aches.

1.title: ES - Heavenly Bites: Mexico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E01 - Micheladas
1.plot: Can you imagine adding lime, candy, seafood and even meat to your beer? Mexicans certainly do, and the result is an addictive drink called michelada.

1.title: ES - Heavenly Bites: Mexico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E02 - More Than Just Chips
1.plot: What makes a simple bag of chips go from basic to epic? The toppings! Sauces, cheese, beans... this urban all-in-one snack is bound to make you drool.

1.title: ES - Heavenly Bites: Mexico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E03 - Sinful Desserts
1.plot: There's always room for dessert, but with this range of delights that go from deep-fried sweets to jello-filled bread, you'll need a second belly.

1.title: ES - Heavenly Bites: Mexico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E04 - Eating by the Kilo
1.plot: A burrito the size of a baby. A ten-tier skyscraper hamburger. We take a tour of some of our old-time favorites but in their jumbo versions.

1.title: ES - Heavenly Bites: Mexico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E05 - The Sweetest of Buns
1.plot: The concha, aka the queen of Mexican pastries, has become a canvas for culinary experimentation. Sweet, savory or filled, it's everybody's muse.

1.title: ES - Heavenly Bites: Mexico [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E06 - Next-Level Tortas
1.plot: Nothing says comfort food like a torta; bread, cut in half, with a thousand things between. The sauce-drenched ahogadas are Guadalajara's big thing.

meta.plot: A child star in the '80s, Samantha clings to the fringes of celebrity with hilarious harebrained schemes to launch herself back into the spotlight.

1.title: PT - Samantha! - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: When Samantha's ex Dodói returns from prison and tries to prove he's a responsible parent, she realizes her career could benefit from his homecoming.

1.title: PT - Samantha! - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Samantha and Dodói shoot a beer commercial together, but the script's storyline proves challenging for both of them in different ways.

1.title: PT - Samantha! - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Brandon tries to whip his father into shape, Samantha guest-stars as a judge on a singing competition show, and Cindy surprises her entire family.

1.title: PT - Samantha! - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Dodói unknowingly hooks up with social media celebrity Laila. Samantha attempts to gain Instagram followers by taking a trip to "Paris."

1.title: PT - Samantha! - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: When Samantha gets pulled into a reality show romance, her entire family is affected. Dodói tests out a career as a sports commentator on the radio.

1.title: PT - Samantha! - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: To turn her bad karma around, Samantha sets out to honor Ciggy's last request: that the Plimplom Gang reunite and spread his ashes in Varre-Sai.

1.title: PT - Samantha! - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: A face from the Plimploms' past returns to drop a bombshell on Samantha. Left at home without adult supervision, Cindy and Brandon get into trouble.

2.title: PT - Samantha! - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: When Samantha's ex-bandmates adapt a tell-all book about her into a movie that publicly denounces her as immature, she sets out to prove them wrong.

2.title: PT - Samantha! - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Dodói spends the day trying to please his mother. Samantha decides to take a break from the media as Tico and Porky cast an actress to play her.

2.title: PT - Samantha! - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Samantha tries out feminism, much to Cindy's dismay. Dodói goes to therapy. Brandon's grandmother persuades him to test out a new passion.

2.title: PT - Samantha! - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: In an attempt to win over an experimental theater director, Samantha attends a party with Dodói, who draws attention. Laila offers Cindy love advice.

2.title: PT - Samantha! - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Carmen struggles to elicit feelings from Samantha, and even resorts to using a straitjacket, as the child star tries to suppress her emotional past.

2.title: PT - Samantha! - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: When Samantha is unable to say the word "orphan," she enlists a specialist to help her mentally return to a pivotal moment in her career.

2.title: PT - Samantha! - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: Following Samantha's somber one-person play, an eager fan kidnaps the actress in order to try and convince her to be happy and optimistic again.

meta.plot: Makoto Misumi is just an ordinary high school student living a regular life, but all of a sudden gets summoned to the other world to become a "hero." The goddess of the other world, however, insults him for being different and strips his "hero" title, before casting him off to the wilderness at the edge of the world. As he wanders the wilderness, Makoto encounters dragons, spiders, orcs, dwarves, and all sorts of non-human tribes. Because Makoto comes from a different world, he is able to unleash unimaginable magical powers and combat skills. But just how will he handle his encounters with various species and survive in his new environment. In this fantasy, Makoto tries to transform the other world into a better place despite the humans and gods having turned their backs on him.

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Failed... Hero
1.plot: Due to certain circumstances, ordinary high school student Misumi Makoto is summoned to another world to become a Hero... at least, he was supposed to be one. However, despised by the Goddess for a ridiculous reason, Makoto is banished to the barren Wasteland. At his wit's end, Makoto wanders the wasteland, where he begins to make friends with Highland orc girl Emma. However, when Makoto learns that she's going to be sacrificed to the greater dragon Shen...

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Black Spider of Disaster
1.plot: Makoto forms a favorable contract with greater dragon Shin. Shin takes him to her demiplane, another world that exists within her mist. Blessed with fertile lands and hidden from the Goddess, Makoto develops the demiplane along with the Highland orcs who have settled there. Meanwhile, outside the demiplane, the Black Spider of Disaster driven to madness by her eternal hunger closes in on the demiplane.

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Human Shock
1.plot: Makoto is entered into a contract with the Black Spider of Disaster while he's unconscious. Despite his confusion, he gives names to Shin and the Black Spider of Disaster. Meanwhile, various demihumans including the elder dwarves begin settling in the demiplane. Surrounded by demihumans, Makoto begins to miss humans and heads to a human town. However, he finds armed humans waiting for him! Why would they do this?!

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Too Late
1.plot: In the human town of Zetsuya, Makoto and company meet a girl named Rinon who is searching for her missing sister. That night, they're attacked at the inn. They learn Rinon's sister Toa is being held captive because of her debt. As Makoto nearly loses his cool for certain reasons, Tomoe and Mio go to rescue Toa instead. However, a single man stands in their way.

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Greedy Wagon's Journey
1.plot: Makoto leaves behind the destroyed town of Zetsuya and travels towards a new town with Toa, Rinon, and other adventurers. While defeating many monsters on the road, the group safely arrives in Tsige. Sorry to see Toa and her party go, Makoto suggests they throw one last party. During the party, Makoto hears an unsettling rumor about the Rembrandt Trading Company, the client of his first job...

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Melancholy of Handsome Middle-Aged Men
1.plot: Makoto's party accepts the Rembrandt Trading Company job. They've already acquired the necessary materials, and their first job as adventurers seems to be going well... But trading company owner Patrick Rembrandt distrusts Makoto, as he lacks any kind of adventuring record. Furthermore, Makoto seeks to join the merchants' guild, where two tests await him.

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Wondrous Medicine Production
1.plot: In order to save Rembrandt's wife and children from the cursed disease afflicting them, Makoto and Hazal get to work producing the wondrous medicine known as ambrosia. After administering the medicine, Makoto prays for their recovery and leaves Rembrandt's mansion. Tomoe and Mio meet up with Makoto after he completes the job. They're attacked by a group of strangers who have been following them since they left the inn...

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Demiplane Ranking
1.plot: Having completed the job for Rembrandt, Makoto is relaxing in the demiplane, but there's a new problem. The Highland orc and lizardmen warriors Makoto and his companions have been training have lost their confidence. Tomoe announces the Demiplane Ranking, a series of one-on-one combats between warriors of all species in order to raise their morale!

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Eat or Be Eaten
1.plot: A feast is held to celebrate the establishment of Kuzunoha Trading Company in the hyuman town. After getting better acquainted with the residents of the demiplane, Makoto sneaks off to practice archery. However, a very flustered Tomoe and Mio show up. Mio suddenly bursts into tears, and Makoto struggles to understand the situation. Just then, Tomoe says something unbelievable!

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Hidden Ogre Village
1.plot: Makoto and Mio visit Tinarak Forest in order to acquire ambrosia flowers for the Kuzunoha Trading Company, but they are attacked by Aqua and Eris, the forest ogres protecting the flowers. Distracted by a deranged Mio and the adventurers who happened to show up, Makoto finds himself cornered. With Tomoe's help, Makoto and Mio escape their predicament. However, at the forest ogre village they visited to negotiate a deal, they get dragged into yet another incident...

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Goodbye
1.plot: A mysterious explosion occurs in the demiplane, and Tomoe collapses. Though Makoto is unsettled by the sudden events, he heads to the site of the explosion in order to treat the wounded. Makoto is shocked to learn the denizens of the demiplane were harmed in the explosion. Meanwhile, he learns the truth from the hyuman memory that enters his mind! What will Makoto do once he discovers the selfish actions they took?!

1.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Guided by the Moon...
1.plot: Makoto departs for the academy... at least, that was the plan. However, the goddess transports Makoto into the middle of a battle between hyumans and demons. There he is attacked by the strongest hyuman adventurer Sofia Bulga and greater dragon Mitsurugi. Having sided with the demons, Sofia and Mitsurugi believe Makoto is the goddess' disciple and attack mercilessly. Facing a crisis, Makoto musters the last strength he has remaining and activates his magic--

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - What? Moon over the Ruined Castle?
2.plot: Mikoto and Shiki are making their way to Rotsgard Academy in hopes of opening a new store. Meanwhile, back in the demiplane, everyone is helping Mio practice her cooking skills by taste-testing her dishes.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - The Heroes Are a Couple of Beauties
2.plot: We meet one of Misumi Makoto's classmates back on earth, who also has a curious encounter with a certain goddess who presides over a certain isekai. She and one other are sent there as heroes to help the hyumans defeat the demons.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Stellar Wars
2.plot: Hibiki and Tomoki's parties prepare for the attack on Fort Stella (the one Makoto ended up being somewhat involved in against his will). The two human heroes couldn't be more different, posing challenges beyond the simple difficulty of facing the demons.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Why Am I a Teacher?!
2.plot: Makoto finally arrives in Rotsgard, but is shocked to find that he's somehow ended up registered to take a teacher's exam instead of one for students. On the way there, he crosses paths with some haughty students of the school...

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - The Lesson Will Now Begin
2.plot: Makoto starts planning his curriculum and class size now that he's employed at Rotsgard Academy. He wants to teach students to expand their use of elemental magic, but his first class seems to think that's simply impossible.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Becoming a Three-Star Chef
2.plot: Makoto is finally able to open his new shop in Rotsgard, but convincing staff to work there rather than Tsige is a bit of a challenge. He later has a talk with Eva about this world's view of marriage, which doesn't sit well with him.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - New Member Audition
2.plot: Makoto returns to the demiplane to check out his new house, which has finally completed construction. He arrives to find that the weather is unseasonably hot, and the source of the problem might be his fault.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - The Notorious Beautiful Sisters
2.plot: Makoto had a busy but fun time in the demiplane. After finishing his business, he returns to Rotsgard with Shiki. Meanwhile, at Rotsgard Academy, Shifu and Yuno Rembrandt have returned to school and will attend a lecture with transfer student Karen Force.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - The Perverted Dragon
2.plot: Lime sets out to investigate hyuman experiments that are secretly being carried out in Rotsgard. He ends up being captured by an underground organization along with Eva. After that, the two manage to escape and meet up with Shin and the others.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Watch as I Improve the World
2.plot: Shin and company begin full-scale action to destroy the underground organization with demon general Rona's help. The group discovers that the mastermind is Bright, an instructor at Rotsgard Academy. Bright's willingness to make sacrifices angers Makoto.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - Summer of Growth and New Skills
2.plot: It's summer vacation for Rotsgard Academy. Makoto spends his time doing miscellaneous work and learning magic. One day it's decided he will have a mock battle against the wingkin. Makoto braces himself against his powerful enemies who are undefeated.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Attack of the Giant Monsters
2.plot: One day near summer's end, the highland orcs are attacked by wolves and bears while exploring the forest. After hearing the news, Makoto goes to the forest in an attempt to make peace between them, but the bear he meets looks upon him with hostility.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - The Very Busy Academy Festival
2.plot: The academy festival is fast approaching. Shinai, a temple priest, arranges a meeting with Makoto on short notice. Shinai informs Makoto about rumors concerning the medicine being sold at the shop and offers Makoto a proposal to help dispel them.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E14 - I'm Not a Fan of High Society
2.plot: Makoto attends a luncheon on the second day of the festival and is approached by Sairitsu, an official with the Laurel Commonwealth. She suspects Makoto may be from another world because of the foreign characters on the Kuzunoha Trading Company's sign.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E15 - A Fierce Tournament
2.plot: Students take on the individual competition in the school festival's highlight event, the combat tournament. Due to a nobleman plot, they are forced to face off against their peers. Jin advances to the finals and faces off against Ilumgand Hopleys.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E16 - A Certain Student's Secret
2.plot: Due to the incident with Zara, Makoto decides to join the demons, and after witnessing the fighting tournament, he decides to leave Rotsgard. The next day, Jin and his friends advance to the finals of the team competition and face a team led by Ilumgand.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E17 - Mutation Hazard
2.plot: Ilumgand was transformed into a monster. Jin and Abelia launch an attack to stop him. However, their attacks have no effect, and they lose their fighting spirit and energy in the face of an enemy stronger than ever.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E18 - Fall of the Academy City
2.plot: Rotsgard's turmoil continues. Numerous mutants have appeared in the city and Jin and his friends attempt to subjugate them. Meanwhile, Mio, who has been ordered by Makoto to protect the shelter, detects a strange smell from Makoto during her mission.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E19 - The Unruly Merchant
2.plot: The mutant turmoil shows no signs of ending. At the evacuation center, people who've transformed into new mutants have appeared, anxiety and fatigue have reached their peak. To change the situation, Misumi's group joins the mutant subjugation force.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E20 - The Utterly Hateable Good-for-Nothing
2.plot: Using the mutant disturbance as a decoy the demon army advances on the Kingdom of Limia and the Empire of Gritonia. The hyuman army tries to intercept them, but are quickly outnumbered and overpowered. The two great powers are on the verge of collapse.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E21 - The Heroes Fight Bravely
2.plot: Tomoe, Mio, and the residents of the demiplane are ordered by Makoto to take back Kaleneon, and enter enemy territory. Meanwhile, in the Gritonia Empire, Tomoki and his friends head to the battlefield, where they encounter Sofia standing in their way.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E22 - Fight On, Hero!
2.plot: Makoto is shaken by the revelation that the hero he meets on the battlefield is his high school senior, Hibiki Otonashi. Unable to dwell on it, Makoto enters a battle with Io to whom he suggests the demons retreat, in order to avoid a pointless battle

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E23 - Rival Revenge Match
2.plot: Sofia suddenly barges into the battle between Makoto and Io. Having longed for a rematch with Makoto, Sofia launches a fierce attack on her nemesis as soon as she steps onto the battlefield. Despite being outnumbered, Makoto appears unfazed.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E24 - Sorcerer vs. Draconid
2.plot: Outside Limia's royal castle, a fierce battle between Shiki and Mitsurugi unfolds. Meanwhile, inside the castle, the battle between Makoto and Sofia continues. Sofia, at a loss, unleashes her secret weapon.

2.title: EN - TSUKIMICHI -Moonlit Fantasy- [MULTI-SUB] - S02E25 - Party Beneath the Moonlight
2.plot: After the battle in Limia, Makoto returns to the demiplane where he is welcomed by Tomoe, Mio and the residents of the demiplane. After a short celebration Makoto returns to Rotsgard to wipe out the remaining mutants, ending the days-long turmoil.

meta.plot: Kotarou Azumi and Akane Mizuno became third year students at junior high school and are classmates for the first time. These two, along with fellow classmates, Chinatsu Nishio and Takumi Hira, relate to their peers through mutual understandings and feelings. As their final year at junior high school progresses, the group overcome their challenges to mature and become aware of changes in themselves.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Spring and Hard Times
1.plot: Kotarou Azumi and Akane Mizuno became third year students at junior high school and are classmates for the first time. These two, along with fellow classmates, Chinatsu Nishio and Takumi Hira, relate to their peers through mutual understandings and feelings. As their final year at junior high school progresses, the group overcome their challenges to mature and become aware of changes in themselves.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A Handful of Sand
1.plot: It's the last sports festival of middle school. Kotarou gets put in the relay race. He becomes friends with one of Akane's friends who bandages his scraped hand.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Howling at the Moon
1.plot: With the school trip looming, the third-years are abuzz with dating gossip. Meanwhile, Kotarou is busy with his writing, and Akane is working on her running performance.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Passing Shower
1.plot: Things get awkward between Kotarou and Akane after he asks her out. He tries to find some time alone with her on the school trip, but sneaking his cell phone past the teachers proves to be a challenge.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Kokoro
1.plot: Akane and Kotarou want to spend more time together at school, but they can never seem to find the time or space. Chinatsu, meanwhile, seems to have no trouble finding ways to hang out with him.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Run, Melos!
1.plot: Akane's big track meet is coming up, but she's flustered by Chinatsu's confession to her that she has a crush on Kotarou.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Hold Back Nothing When Taking Love
1.plot: Chinatsu invites Akane, Kotarou and Hira to Tokyo Dome City amusement park. She makes a last-ditch effort.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Vita Sexualis
1.plot: Word gets around that Kotarou and Akane are in a relationship.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Wind Rises
1.plot: Despite the stressful changes that come with the transition from middle school to high school, Kotarou and Akane have each other to lean on—for now.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Setting Sun
1.plot: Akane decides to apply to a school in Chiba that her parents and Takumi recommended. She meets with Kotaro, who says he will try to apply to the same one and that, regardless, they will be together. The track club later goes to Kotaro’s festival.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - An Encouragement of Learning
1.plot: Kotaro begins studying incredibly hard to go to Akane’s school, despite not having sufficient grades. Initially, his mother is elated, having earlier criticized his hobbies as distractions. However, at a PTS conference, Kotaro reveals his true intentions, straining his relationship with his parents. Meanwhile, in addition to studying, Akane starts knitting a scarf for Kotaro.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - And Then
1.plot: Kotaro learns that he was not accepted into Akane’s school, saddening them. Daisuke suggests Kotaro use it in his writing, while Ayane suggests Akane should break up with him rather than do long-distance.

1.title: EN - Tsukigakirei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 -

meta.plot: In this "romantic comedy but sometime serious magical school story," life as Arata Kasuga knows it is wiped out by a bizarre incident known as "Collapse Phenomenon," which causes worldwide destruction and takes his cousin Hijiri Kasuga to the next world. To resolve the "Collapse Phenomenon" and bring back Hijiri, Arata enrolls in the Royal Biblia Academy. Waiting in the school are seven beautiful female magic users — the Trinity Seven.

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Administer and Third Selection
1.plot: Arata Kasuga, a high school student, is being targeted by a girl with humongous boobs. In exchange for his life, Lilith says that she can erase his memories, but he chooses the third option. As a result, he ends up at a magic school, but why is there a naked girl in the men's bath?

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Prison Lock and Grimoire Security
1.plot: In order to become a mage, you need a research theme which archives one of the seven deadly sins. While thinking about what his theme will be, Arata and 3 others are locked in a barrier, with no exit to be found. But then Lilith and the others find themselves needing to use the restroom... Good luck, girls!

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Magus and Alchemist
1.plot: It's summer. The gang's on a southern island, and there's cute girls in swimsuits abound. Arata's cooking yakisoba for some reason, but these things happen. The quartermaster is repairing the school that Arata destroyed in his collapse phenomenon. The girls enjoy a mixed-gender bath, and the demon lord candidate decides on a theme--control.

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Labyrinth and Magic Gunner
1.plot: A power leaks from underneath the school, Arata and the gang head down into the labyrinth to protect the school from the collapse phenomenon.

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Dream World and Sub-Administer
1.plot: The girls are running in their exercise outfits, with the boobs swaying to and fro. Arata's heart races. Everyone's having great time, and then a ghost appears in the library. Arata and the gang go to check it out, and are forcefully transported to the "Eternal Library". There they find the lost Trinity Seven!

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Dark Mage and Big Event
1.plot: Liese, the last Trinity Seven, appears in the Eternal Library bearing a demon lord seal, making her a demon lord candidate, as well. She tries to entice Arata to join the evil mage side to help save Hijiri, and kisses Arata while he's unsure what to do. Arata has his magic stolen from him, and Liese decides to attack the school.

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Lost Technica and Problem Solving
1.plot: The headmaster's grimoire, Solomon's Gate, has activated. Even high level mages go crazy if they stare at it too long. Liese escapes battle with the headmaster, and attacks Arata and the others, where she uses her ultimate secret technique, Final Crest. And then, the school in the West falls when Liese freezes time...

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Study and Holiday
1.plot: Arata is appointed to be the second in charge for the censorship committee. The whole gang is transported to the destroyed Royal Liber Magic Academy, and there he finds his long lost cousin, but...

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Bible Battle and Sweet Memory
1.plot: Arata and the others appear in a world floating in a rift in the sea of parallel dimensions. Monsters attack. The legendary grimoire, "Fragments of the Iliad" challenges them to a fight. An evil power awakes in Arata due to his anger when the Astil Codex are sealed...

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Game Master and Satan Slave
1.plot: The ultimate demon lord, Astral Trinity, shows up in the form of Arata with a grotesque new appearance. Hijiri appears as well, and the others discover that she is a high-level mage whose goal is to kill Arata and destroy the school.

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Fianna Knights and Sisters
1.plot: Lugh attacks the school while Arata and Mira are being held far away. Yui evacuates everyone in the school into her dream to protect them, and Levi sets out to fight alone. But Lugh is a demon lord candidate who has obtained a demon lord element.

1.title: EN - Trinity Seven [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Criminal Girl and His World
1.plot: It's the last episode, and Hijiri and Arata have their final showdown. Lugh joins in the fight, along with the Trinity Seven--Lilith, Levi, Arin, Mira, Akio, Yui, and Liese. Why is she attacking Arata? And what secret does Arata hold?

meta.plot: Nasa Yuzaki falls in love at first sight after an encounter with the mysterious Tsukasa. When Nasa earnestly confesses his feelings, she replies, "I'll date you, but only if we're married." Nasa and Tsukasa's cute and precious newlywed life of love is about to begin!

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Marriage
1.plot: Nasa Yuzaki was preparing for his high school entrance exams one snowy night when he spots a beautiful girl on the other side of the road. Feeling somewhat drawn to her, he walks towards the girl and is severely injured after getting run over by a truck. Despite hanging on for dear life, Nasa still walks over to the girl and knowing this may indeed be his last chance, confesses his feelings for her. She replies, “I’ll go out with you if you marry me.” Nasa immediately agrees but then loses consciousness. A few years later, he keeps busy at his part-time job, believing they’ll be reunited again someday. One day, someone randomly shows up at his doorstep. It happens to be the girl he shared that fateful encounter with.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The First Night
1.plot: Nasa and Tsukasa have submitted their marriage registration. As the newlywed couple approaches their first night together, they realize Nasa’s apartment doesn’t have enough necessities for two people, leading to Tsukasa suggesting she spend the night at a hotel. But Nasa stops her, and proposes they go shopping instead. After returning home, Tsukasa sleeps relaxedly while Nasa is tense with excitement from seeing a new side of his wife.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Sisters
1.plot: Nasa and Tsukasa’s newlywed life has finally begun. The two of them head to a bathhouse run by a girl who went to middle-school with Nasa, Arisugawa Kaname. Kaname is shocked to see Nasa with a girl, and is curious about what happened after learning about the marriage. Meanwhile, Tsukasa heads into the bath and encounters Kaname’s sister Aya. When she asks Tsukasa about her connection to Nasa, Tsukasa replies that they are family.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Promise
1.plot: As Tsukasa waits for Nasa to return home, a young girl named Chitose, who calls her “Nee-sama” confronts her. Chitose asks for Tsukasa to come home with her, and after being ignored, encounters Nasa. He tries to cheer her up, but after learning that Nasa is the one married to Tsukasa, Chitose’s attitude suddenly changes. As Nasa tries to explain, Chitose shoves him into a black car that then drives away.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Rings
1.plot: During the ruckus as the Kaginoji house, Nasa and Tsukasa pledge their love to each other at a church. After Nasa reports to Kaname that he has finally proposed, she points that he still doesn’t have a ring. Although he doesn’t take much notice at first, Nasa gradually becomes more self-consciousness about the role of a ring in newlywed life.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - News
1.plot: Nasa realizes he’s been so enthralled with newlywed life he forgot to tell his parents he’s gotten married. He tries to wrap it up with a simple phone call, but Tsukasa decides she wants to meet his parents. While Nasa is anxious about a potentially embarrassing meeting, the two of them head to visit Nasa’s parents in Nara.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Trip
1.plot: Nasa and Tsukasa take an overnight bus to visit his parents in Nara. They attempt to enjoy the trip like a honeymoon, when Chitose shows up at a service area, asking to know why Tsukasa married Nasa, who happens to overhear the conversation and begins to wonder the same thing. As the couple attempt to enjoy seeing the sights in Kyoto, Chitose appears again. She attempts to test Nasa to see if he’s worthy to be married to Tsukasa, and he explains why he decided to marry her.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Parents
1.plot: Nasa and Tsukasa arrive in Nara and head to the Yuzaki family’s house. Despite demanding to meet Tsukasa, Nasa’s parents, Enishi and Kanoka, are both clearly nervous. And not long after introductions, Enishi ends up making a deal with Tsukasa.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Daily Life
1.plot: After returning from Nara, Tsukasa and Nasa find themselves without a home thanks to a freak lightning strike. Nasa's prepper habits keep the damage to a minimum, but they still find themselves temporarily homeless, until someone offers to let them stay in a spare room. And so, the newlyweds begin their stay at the Arisugawa house.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Way Home
1.plot: Nasa and Tsukasa are now enjoying newlywed life as guests of the Arisugawa family. Things proceed normally until they receive a call from Nasa's previous landlord, offering them an apartment at a newly constructed building. The two of them go to check out a showroom of their potential new home, arriving at a high-rise apartment building.

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Friends
1.plot: Nasa suggests takoyaki party to the Arisugawa sisters so that everyone can get to know each other better. Meanwhile, Chitose tracks Tsukasa down to the bathhouse. The game-loving Aya finds herself getting along with the two of them, and before long competitive sparks start flying!

1.title: EN - TONIKAWA: Over the Moon for You [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Husband and Wife
1.plot: Nasa comes down with a fever while at work. Despite his claims of being fine, Tsukasa takes him to the hospital and starts to nurse him back to health. After recovering, the two of them head to a summer festival. When Nasa begins to wonder about how many people out there worry about him, Tsukasa has something to say.

meta.plot: The year is 2205. The "historical revisionists" have begun attacks on the past in their plot to change history. The Saniwa, who have been charged with protecting history, can imbue life into objects. Strongest among these are the Tōken Danshi. The story centers around their cheerful lives.

meta.plot: Tsuyoshi Mukohda, an ordinary salaryman, is suddenly transported to another world one day. The unique skill he gains upon arrival in this world is the seemingly useless "Online Grocery." Mukohda is discouraged at first, but the modern foods he's able to bring to his new world using this skill prove to have some unbelievable effects!

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - My Absurd Skill Is Unexpectedly Useful
1.plot: One day, Tsuyoshi Mukohda, an extremely ordinary salaryman, gets caught up in a hero summons being performed in another world. At the time of his summoning, he receives a unique skill known as "Online Grocery", that allows him to bring food ingredients and seasonings from his original world. Even though this skill seems plain at first glance, the food he brings into this new world has an absurd effect...!?

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Salient Familiar Is a Living Legend
1.plot: After the legendary wolf monster Fenrir got attracted to the delicious smell of Mukohda's food and signed the Familiar Contract with him, Mukohda decides to register with the Guild in Fallières his next stop.

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - My Super Power Is All About Cooking
1.plot: After registering with both the Merchant's and the Adventurer's Guilds, Mukohda immediately decides to take on a beginner’s quest. However, when they deliver the monsters that Fel caught during their quest to the Guild, they find out that most of these monsters are B-rank or higher.

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Cannot Start the Journey Without a Map
1.plot: Mukohda asks Fel to teach him how to use magic after witnessing his wind magic. However, when things do not seem to go well, Fel decides to start a Spartan training regimen for him.

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Goddess of Wind Has a Sweet Tooth
1.plot: Mukohda  and Fel arrive at a large lake, where they catch some fish and have their usual meal. But right when they start eating inside the barrier that keeps monsters at bay, a baby slime appears out of nowhere...?

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Growth Happens Out of Nowhere
1.plot: The place Fel decides to bring Mukohda to get some battle experience ends up being a creepy dungeon. Even so, Mukohda gets ready for battle and increases his stats by eating a meal from his original world using the “Online Grocery”. However...

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Dances with Wolves and Monsters
1.plot: Mukohda and his familiars dash through the forest, after strengthening their bonds in the dungeon. However, they soon find themselves in the territory of dangerous monsters and, just like Mukohda expected, surrounded by a pack of orthros...

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - All of the Boss Monsters Are Tasty
1.plot: After Mukohda rescues a traveling caravan from a band of bandits, they set out together for the great city of Karelina. But when Mukohda visits the Adventurer’s Guild in the city, he gets notified that his membership was revoked...?

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Hunting Quests Are All About Meat and Money
1.plot: Mukohda gets summoned by the guild master after defeating an entire settlement of goblins while finishing a guild request. Although Mukohda didn't want to make a big deal out of it, he receives a high-ranking quest directly from the guild master...?

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - My Two Familiars Are Too Overpowered
1.plot: Mukohda and his familiars receive a request to head towards a mine and hunt down the metal lizard that inhabits it. Instead, they run into a rare mithril lizard. After Mukohda defeats the lizard, with the help of Fel and Sui, Fel turns his interest towards a different and tastier prey...?

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Doing Business for The Missus
1.plot: Lambert consults Mukohda about a gift for his wife. When Mukohda suggests a certain product he purchased from the online grocery, it leads to an unexpected situation. Meanwhile, a pack of dangerous monsters, called wyverns, are approaching the town...?

1.title: EN - Campfire Cooking in Another World with My Absurd Skill [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Adventures Are as Countless as Varieties of Food
1.plot: After easily defeating the pack of dangerous yet powerful wyverns, Mukohda and his familiars receive praise not only from the guild, but also from the entire town. Unfazed by the attention, Mukohda goes out to look for a certain thing that he's always wanted to get in ever since he got summoned to this world.

meta.plot:
The first astronaut in human history was a vampire girl.

Following the end of World War II, the world-dividing superpowers, Federal Republic of Zirnitra in the East and United Kingdom of Arnack in the West, turned their territorial ambitions toward space. Both countries have been competing fiercely for development.

East history 1960. Gergiev, the chief leader of the Republic, announces the manned space flight program Project Mechtat (Dream), which, if successful, would be the first feat for humankind. At that time, Lev Leps, a substitute astronaut candidate, is ordered to perform a top secret mission. The "Nosferatu Project"—a program that experiments with vampires prior to manned missions—will use Irina Luminesk as a test subject, and Lev is to monitor and train her.

Even while trifled by the walls of the race and ego of the nations, Lev and Irina share a genuine sentiment as they aim for the universe.

1.title: EN - Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Nosferatu Project
1.plot: In his motherland's race to claim the first human spaceflight, cosmonaut candidate Lev Leps is assigned to a secret project which involves an outrageous experiment.

1.title: EN - Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Path to Becoming a Cosmonaut
1.plot: Lev takes Irina through the cosmonaut training routine. While she surprises Lev and Anya in some aspects, other areas give her trouble.

1.title: EN - Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Night Flight
1.plot: As the voices opposing Irina's existence become louder and louder, Lev comes up with a special plan to help overcome her fear of heights.

1.title: EN - Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Promise by the Lake
1.plot: With less than a month until launch, Lev takes Irina into town for a little fun before she dives into days of solitude training.

1.title: EN - Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Training Separately
1.plot: While Irina undergoes her solitude training, a visitor from Sangrad with special interest in N44 has come to watch the candidates train.

1.title: EN - Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Nosferatu
1.plot: A terrible dream leaves Irina shaken and unable to continue training. As Anya and Lev try to get her back on track, there's even more bad news about the test flight.

1.title: EN - Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Lycoris Cooking Show
1.plot: Though Lev is confined due to his actions, the launch must go on as scheduled. As Irina takes to the skies, those on the ground pray for a successful mission.

1.title: EN - Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - A Maiden's Prayer
1.plot: Now that the test launch is over, Lev is given new orders. His training pulls him apart from Irina who falls into Anya's care over New Years.

1.plot: An incident during training sheds some light on Roza's fierce attitude. And after a long time apart, Irina has something important to tell Lev.

1.title: EN - Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - A Cold Spring
1.plot: Irina and Lev spend some time together before they're pulled apart. As the launch date quickly closes in, the decision is made as to who will pilot the first human spaceflight.
