1.plot: With the whole world listening, Lev wants to make sure Irina isn't forgotten. But the Delivery Crew has their own plans for Irina and plots to seize her during the ceremony.

meta.plot: When Minato Narumiya joins Prefectural Kazemai High School, he is quickly invited to join the archery club by the club's advisor, Tommy-sensei. His childhood friends Seiya Takehaya and Ryohei Yamanouchi swiftly agree to join, but Minato is hesitant at first. Because Minato is the rare student with experience in archery, Tommy-sensei orders him to give a demonstration, which Minato does... except his arrow doesn't hit the target. It is revealed that Minato has developed a terrible dysfunction regarding archery.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Young Man on the Shooting Range
1.plot: Minato first watched kyudo--Japanese archery--with his mother, where he was enchanted by the sound of the bowstring. When he first arrives at Kazemai High School, everyone expects him to join the kyudo club. But Minato is haunted by a recent tournament failure, and the strange condition that led to it.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - At Wit's End
1.plot: After his failure at the kyudo club briefing, Minato flees the school, and ends up encountering a mysterious archer named Masa-san. Though on his guard at first, Masa-san's lighthearted personality slowly helps him to open up.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Just as They Met
1.plot: When Minato finally joins the Kazemai Kyudo Club, most of the boys accept him immediately. Kaito alone holds a grudge over Minato's wishy-washy behavior. Minato tries to smooth things over, but.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Poor Fit
1.plot: As the team's new coach, Masa-san decides to hold a training camp to help the kyudo club pass the tournament preliminaries. But first, he holds a mock tournament within the club, with a humiliating punishment for the loser.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Frequent Messenger
1.plot: For losing the match, the boys have to act as servants during their training camp. But does working all day mean they'll have no time to practice kyudo?

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Reason for Shooting
1.plot: At Kirisaki, a private high school with a renowned kyudo club, the first-year Fujiwara Shu's skill with a bow stands out. This holds true even when choosing their participants for the prefectural preliminaries.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Reunion
1.plot: The prefectural tournament preliminaries finally begin. When the students from Kazemai and Kirisaki run into each other, Minato is happy to see Shu again - but Kaito is only interested in picking a fight.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Taking Aim
1.plot: The boys finally compete in the group match. While Kaito is focused on making up for his individuals performance, Minato is reinvigorated by his reunion with Shu.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - An Unshown Hand
1.plot: The Kazemai Kyudo Club has managed to break through the preliminaries and is now preparing for finals. But Seiya's seemingly unflappable demeanor is beginning to show cracks.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Linked Heart
1.plot: When Seiya develops a fever and stays home from school, friction develops between the remaining members of the team. Does Masa-san hold a trump card to solve their problems?

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Pain of Empty Release
1.plot: Seiya has bounced back from his earlier gloom, and the team is practicing in earnest for the tournament. But when Minato forgets something in the Kyudo Hall, he overhears Masa-san talking to Tommy-sensei.

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Five Arrows
1.plot: The news of Masa-san's accident has shaken the boys of the Kazemai kyudo club. The girls manage to get their heads back in the game, but will they be able to pass through to the finals under these conditions?

1.title: EN - Tsurune [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Irreplaceable
1.plot: Having overcome various trials, the members of the reborn Kazemai Kyudo Club have deepened the bonds that they share. As the final match of the tournament approaches, what will the future hold for these young men who have grown together through kyudo?

meta.plot:
Just when Masato thought that a random survey conducted in school was over, he got involved in a secret Government scheme. As he was carried along with the flow, he ended up in a Game world! As if that wasn't enough, shockingly, his mother was there as well! It was a little different from a typical transported to another world setting, but after some bickering,

"Mom wants go on an adventure together with Maa-kun. Can mom become Maa-kun's companion?"

With that, Masato and Mamako began their adventure as a mother and son pair. They met Porta, a cute traveling merchant, and Wise, a regrettable philosopher. Along with their new party members, Masato and co. start on their journey.

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Boy Thought He Was Embarking on a Great Adventure… But, Uh, What’s Going on Here?
1.plot: Teenage boy Masato Oosuki was chosen to beta test a new MMORPG, where you're actually teleported inside the world of the game. But once he gets there, he finds his mother has followed him, and she's incredibly strong, too.

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - It’s Just a Coincidence They’re All Girls. Got That? Wipe That Smirk Off Your Face.
1.plot: Mamako and Masato are now registered as hero and mommy, and they decide to have an interview to decide who’ll join their party.

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Underwear is Armor. Make Sure It’s High in Defense. Otherwise, My Son Might Die!
1.plot: Wise joins the party as they prepare to visit the village of Maman on a special quest that Shirase gave them. But first they have to buy equipment, and Mamako is overjoyed at the idea of going shopping with her son.

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Kids Are Kids and Parents Are Parents (but Also Human Beings), and It Takes All Kinds, but They Get Through It Together, Right?
1.plot: The "Empress of Night" turns out to be none other than Wise's mother, who she split up with after a fight. When the two of them went their separate ways, the Empress decided to stop playing the game and instead go chasing after attractive men.

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - This is a Territory for Children, Filled With Hopes and Dreams. For Children. That's the Important Part!
1.plot: Masato, Wise, and Porta become students at Lover’s Lane Academia. Studying here will give them lots of SP and tons of special items. At school they meet a sweet and shy healer named Medhi, and Masato is convinced he’s found the true heroine.

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - What a Beautiful Girl... Wait, Not You, Mom. Don't Get Near Me in That Outfit, Stop!
1.plot: With Shirase’s help, Mamako is allowed to attend the school as well. Just like Medhimama, she becomes an observer in Masato’s class. When Medhimama finds out that her magic doesn’t work on Mamako, she decides that Mamako is her new rival.

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Students are the Protagonists of a School Festival. But People Wearing School Uniforms are Included, Too.
1.plot: The person who’d been whispering her hate about Medhimama was actually Medhi herself. Medhi was loyally doing what her mother told her to, but was secretly feeling extremely stressed and angry. When Masato and his mom find out about this, they decide they want to help her. Meanwhile, the school holds a festival, and parents are allowed to participate. The group decides to open a small café where Mamako will cook. Medhimama opens a café of her own, and insists on competing with Mamako to see who can sell more. Mamako reluctantly agrees, but…

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - If I Say Nothing, It Won't Be Heard, But If I Say Something, It'll Be a Critical Hit. It Sucks Being a Family.
1.plot: Medhi was able to say what she felt about her mom when Masato was around, but in front of her mother, she always forced herself to act obedient. Wise and Porta both try to cheer her up and be her friend, but Medhimama, who wants a good daughter so that she can become “the number one mom”, refuses to let her have any friends. When Medhi realizes that her mother’s fanaticism was just for the sake of her own ego, she breaks down, lets her feelings loose, and becomes a powerful dragon. The party tries to stop her, but even in the middle of the fight, Medhimama is so obsessed with being number one that she challenges Mamako to a duel!

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Whoa, There's a Pressure Plate in a Place Like This. Well, I'm Not Stepping On It. No, I'm Saying I Won't!
1.plot: Medhi decides to come along with Masato and the party. They all get a notice about a new "tower dungeon", which will grant any wish to those who can get to the top. The party heads to the town of Ommym, where the dungeon awaits. As soon as they arrive, a group of mothers begs them to look for their children. Shirase says that this isn’t part of any event, however. They decide to investigate the dungeon with her. As they get past the traps and the monsters, they’re met by a woman dressed like a gladiator.

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The With Mommy Guild Welcomes All! ...Wait, It's a Bunch of Uninvited Guests!
1.plot: The girl who stood in the party's way announced herself as "Amante, Betrayer of Mothers", and told them that she belonged to the rebel group "Ribele". She also told them that she'd gotten the adventurers in town to join her party and help her clear the dungeon. She told them all this despite the fact that they hadn't asked her any of it. The party decided that it needed lots of help to free the adventurers from Amante, and retreated. They opened the "With Mommy" guild, and began to recruit. But Amante's helper, Pocchi, came to stop them. He and his buddies made a certain demand of Mamako, and told her that if she didn't do what they wanted, they’d use bombs to blow up the city!

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Courage to Accept Things. A Loving Heart. Also, Full-Body Armor. That's What a Mother Needs... Wait, Armor?
1.plot: After being touched by Mamako's motherly kindness, Pocchi and his friends changed their ways and went home to their mothers. As a way of saying thank you, the mothers agree to join the With Mommy guild, and help the party clear the tower. There are still a lot of children who are working for Amante. And so the party, now filled with mothers, heads off to the tower, gossiping and chatting all the way. When this not-very-adventurous party makes it inside the dungeon, they’re met by Amante, who’s gotten sick of waiting for them. She challenges Mamako to… a washing and cleaning contest?!

1.title: EN - Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I Hoped Against Hope the Wish Would Not Be Granted. But It Totally Was
1.plot: Masato's party makes their way up the tower. They meet Pocchi on the way up, who tells them that Amante's plan is to clear the dungeon and wish for all mothers to disappear. They have to stop her! Meanwhile, Amante has made it to the top of the 100 floor tower, and defeated the last boss, but she can't get into the wish-granting room. Masato's party arrives and challenges her to a duel. During the middle of the battle, Amante tells Mamako that her presence here is stealing away her son's future! Mamako is caught off guard. But instead, Masato...

meta.plot:
Here in this magic academy city of Ashram, where everyone is required to live in dormitories, a close-knit group of girls known as “Pentagrams” pursue their studies, including training in manners and magic, to become “true ladies.”

Arsnotoria, one of the students in Ashram, lives in Dorm 5 and is always with her dormmate friends: Mel, who’s the life of the party, Petit Albert, who’s quiet and does things at her own pace, Picatrix, who wants to be the class president, and Abramelin, who’s always cool. They take classes and work on their school duties together, and they throw tea parties after school in “that room”…

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Sniff, Sniff, Sniff
1.plot: Arsnotoria, Mell, Little Alberta, Picatrix, and Abramelin get together (in that room) again! While they thought it would be a regular fun tea time, somehow it turns into a fight over how to eat scones?!

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Hug!!!
1.plot: In order to protect the school grounds from the ever present threat of the bugs, today it's Arsnotoria's turn to be on extermination duty. Mell, Little Alberta, Picatrix, and Abramelin all rush to her side to help her with this activity. But then, one word from their shadow cat teacher Perdura puts the entire school into a frenzy!?

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Sniff......
1.plot: One morning, Arsnotoria loses her sense of smell. Noticing this, Mell, Little Alberta, Picatrix, and Abramelin attempt to employ "shock therapy" by gathering all sorts of "intense smells" so that Arsnotoria can regain her sense of smell.

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Ding Dong
1.plot: Today is the day for the special night lessons. Arsnotoria and her friends enjoy the campus at night while making their way over to headmaster Solow for a hands-on session of magical botany. When they get to the moonlit greenhouse, they see something they've never seen before!

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Sn-...
1.plot: Mell and Little Alberta play hide and seek with lowerclassmen, Picatrix does her homework, and Abramelin spends her time doing research. Meanwhile Arsnotoria makes her way to the great library tower to share a late lunch with "a certain person".

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Shh—
1.plot: The Pentagrams have to go shopping in the outside world, but some items are out of stock!

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Coo coo coo
1.plot: Picatrix is trying to keep up with the latest fashion trends from London, so the Pentagrams try to get their hands on bird feathers.

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Wa—
1.plot: Little Alberta follows glowing rings of blue light into a cave, but soon after she realizes that she is trapped.

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Uh~ Uh~ Uo~~
1.plot: Since it is so rare for Ashlam to get snow, today's lesson plan for the Pentagrams is to play a lot in the snow.

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - SSSS-----
1.plot: After Solow sees Pentagram running in the hallway, she decides to hold a special lesson on how to walk like a lady.

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - On three
1.plot: Mell picks up a cat's whisker, considered a lucky charm, which kicks off an interesting chain of events.

1.title: EN - Smile of the Arsnotoria the Animation [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Sniff!
1.plot: In preparation for Grand Alberta's return, Little Alberta and the others go to purchase snacks and after taking a shortcut on their way back, they settle in for tea time.

meta.plot: Join animal pals Kiki, Dewey, Hazzy, Luly and Teshi as they learn how to make friends, try new foods and face other big firsts in colorful Roo City!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E01 - First Potty Accident
1.plot: It's Hazzy's turn to lead the pajama parade, but he needs to go to the potty. What should he do to avoid an accident? Stop — and listen to his body!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E02 - First Time Making New Friends
1.plot: Kiki is new to Roo City and wants to meet friends at the playground. She feels shy at first — but soon discovers that saying hello is a great start!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E03 - First Morning Routine
1.plot: Luly wants to dance before nature class, but skipping her morning checklist will make her late. She learns that a routine keeps everything on track!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E04 - First Time I Couldn't Fall Asleep
1.plot: The Groovin' Roos concert is tomorrow, and Dewey is too excited to sleep! But if he doesn't calm down, he'll be too tired to enjoy the show.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E05 - First Glasses
1.plot: Teshi's first trip to the eye doctor is full of new experiences. But asking questions and paying attention during the visit makes him feel less scared.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E06 - First Sunburn
1.plot: It's pool party time, and Kiki's ready for some fun in the sun. But when she decides to skip out on the sunscreen, she gets a painful sunburn. Ouch!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E07 - First Snowy Day
1.plot: It's snowing in Roo City, and Dewey wants to play outside with his pals! But will he take the time to put on warm winter clothes to stay safe and cozy?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E08 - First Time Trying a New Food
1.plot: Hazzy's unsure about tasting a pickle for the first time. But with Teshi and Luly cheering him on, he might just discover a yummy new snack!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E09 - First Time Losing Something Special
1.plot: When Teshi can't find his favorite stuffed animal, he learns to handle the feelings of losing something important to him with the support of his friends.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E10 - First Compromise
1.plot: Luly and Kiki are baking cookies for their friends but can't agree on a surprise ingredient. Can they come up with a solution that makes them both happy?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E11 - First Apology
1.plot: Kiki covers Teshi's puppet, Little T, with bubbles at Hazzy's car wash, which makes Teshi upset. Can Kiki fix things up with an apology?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E12 - First Time Getting a Shot
1.plot: Hazzy's worried about getting his first shot at the doctor. Will sharing his feelings with the other Wonderoos help him feel better?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E13 - First Time I Had to Be Calm
1.plot: Dewey's excited to see dinosaur bones and other exhibits at the museum. But he has to learn how to calm down before visiting a special room about space.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E14 - First Time Talking About Differences
1.plot: Hazzy's painting a picture of the Wonderoos! When Luly notices that Hazzy missed one of her special features, will she say something — or keep it inside?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E15 - First Long Wait
1.plot: There's a long line for the magic show, and Teshi doesn't want to wait! Will he skip the show or enjoy the time with his pals?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E16 - First Time Getting Lost
1.plot: Hazzy wanders away from Luly to play a game at the carnival, then realizes he's lost. It's always best to stick with a buddy — and now he knows!

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E17 - First Time at the Dentist
1.plot: Kiki has her very first dentist visit, then goes home for a fun sleepover with friends. But will she do the right thing and brush her teeth before bed?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E18 - First Time I Didn't Want to Tell the Truth
1.plot: As the Wonderoos set up a surprise birthday party for Hazzy, Dewey sneaks a bite of the cake. Will he tell the truth when his friends ask what happened?

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E19 - First Time Playing On My Own
1.plot: It's raining outside, so Hazzy wants to have some fun indoors! But since the other Wonderoos are busy, he'll have to learn to play on his own.

1.title: EN - Wonderoos [MULTI-SUB-AUDIO] - S01E20 - First Time I Had to Put My Screen Away
1.plot: While Teshi is busy with his new tablet, his friends are having a blast at the park: Will he set his screen aside so he can play with them?

meta.plot: 4400 overlooked, undervalued, or otherwise marginalized people who vanished without a trace over the last hundred years are all returned in an instant, having not aged a day and with no memory of what happened to them. As the government races to analyze the potential threat and contain the story, the 4400 themselves must grapple with the fact that they've been returned with a few "upgrades", and the increasing likelihood that they were all brought back now for a specific reason.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E01 - Past Is Prologue
1.plot: Over the last century at least four thousand four hundred people who were overlooked, undervalued, or otherwise marginalized vanished without a trace off the face of the planet. Last night, inexplicably, they were all returned in an instant to Detroit having not aged a day and with no memory of what happened to them.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E02 - All Things Are Possible
1.plot: As the 4400 become even more disenchanted with their accommodations, new rules have everyone on edge. Andre and LaDonna help Claudette push her newfound ability to new limits. Shanice gets an unexpected visitor.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E03 - That LaDonna Life
1.plot: LaDonna signs up for 15 more minutes of fame but quickly realizes she doesn't have the clout she once had. Jharrell picks an inopportune time to speak his truth, and it may cost him dearly. Andre is eager to get back to medicine.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E04 - Harlem's Renaissance Man
1.plot: Finally there is some good news for a few of the 4400. Andre looks to study some of his new friends but mistakes from his past begin to affect him in present day. Rev finds some information about his son.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E05 - The Way We Were
1.plot: Keisha hears the truth about the day she lost her sister, moving her to take a chance. Shanice and Andre enjoy a day out. Hayden and Mariah grow closer.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E06 - If You Love Something
1.plot: Jharrel and Keisha must earn the trust of the 4400 if they want to help keep them safe. Hayden convinces LaDonna and Andre to visit Ypsi Med and Rev continues to grow his flock.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E07 - Empowered Women Empower Women
1.plot: Claudette begins to assert her independence. Rev keeps his flock close, further raising Jharrel's suspicions. LaDonna considers her next move. Keisha has a date with Jessica. Andre is concerned by his latest discovery.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E08 - The Kaminski Experiment
1.plot: Logan's adjustment to Shanice's return has been harder than he let on, meanwhile, Rev is beginning to see the light. Mildred lets her emotions get the better of her, possibly endangering the rest of the 4400.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E09 - Great Expectations
1.plot: The scene is chaotic, and everyone is still reeling after Mildred's on camera performance, meanwhile the government tries to figure out their next move. Rev is confused by his new ability, Jharrel get some unexpected news, and no one seems to know Ladonna's whereabouts.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E10 - Give Up the Ghost
1.plot: With everyone at the Bois Blanc still on edge, the government deals another blow to the 4400. Meanwhile, Jharrel gets some shocking information about his brother, Shanice and Andre continue to grow closer, and Mildred resurfaces.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E11 - You Only Meant Well
1.plot: While Shanice helps to prepare the Bois Blanc for a celebration, others are preparing for war. LaDonna returns to the hotel and we learn what she has experienced out in the real world and what she knows about the 44orum. After a disturbing incident, Hayden realizes the comfort of Kaminsky home may not be what is safest for everyone. Jharrell reunites with his brother but is Manny to be trusted and what is his connection to Claudette? Meanwhile, an unfortunate misunderstanding might prove fatal for one of the 4400.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E12 - Group Efforts
1.plot: Logan is the only witness to a savage crime, that, to all others does not seem to exist, meanwhile Claudette stands up to a group of anti-4400's. Mildred rallies the troops when she fears Milicent might be in trouble and we get a glimpse into the sisters' lives growing up and the mysterious Caleb.

1.title: FR - 4400 - S01E13 - Present is Prologue
1.plot: Tensions rise as an attack is made on the Bois Blanc, putting everyone’s life in danger. Shanice and Logan do their best to keep Hayden safe, while Claudette and Jharrell try to reason with Manny. Meanwhile, Mildred still believes her sister can be saved and LaDonna takes to the streets in an effort to end the threat against the 4400.

meta.plot: Akira Fudo learns from his best friend Ryo Asuka that demons will revive and reclaim the world from humans. With humans hopeless against this threat, Ryo suggests combining with a demon. With this, Akira becomes Devilman, a being with the power of demon but with a human heart.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E01 - I Need You
1.plot: Ryo, a young professor returning from research abroad, takes his pure-hearted, crybaby friend Akira to a decadent party, where things turn demonic.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E02 - One Hand Is Enough
1.plot: Akira has become a completely different man -- he's stronger and hungrier than ever before. He seeks out Ryo for answers.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E03 - Believe Me!
1.plot: After getting shut down by his editor, paparazzo Nagasaki gets desperate. Silene and Kaim learn what happened to their missing fellow demon, Amon.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E04 - Come, Akira
1.plot: Akira's mother calls and says she'll be home soon. Everyone is looking forward to seeing her, but Ryo warns Akira not to trust any human.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E05 - Beautiful Silene
1.plot: Silene tracks down Amon, hoping to reawaken his demonic side. But in the ensuing battle, the human soul of Akira remains powerful.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E06 - Neither Demon nor Human
1.plot: At a widely broadcast track meet, Ryo plans to expose high school athlete Koda as a demon, thereby spreading fear and distrust throughout society.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E07 - Weak Humans, Wise Demons
1.plot: With the fear of demons gripping the world, humanity devolves into paranoia and violence. Akira tries to save other demon-human hybrids like himself.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E08 - I Must Know Myself
1.plot: Ryo's actions and motives remain a mystery to himself, so he revisits his past for answers. Miki's father searches for his missing wife and son.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E09 - Go to Hell, You Mortals
1.plot: Betrayed and exposed, Akira becomes a target. After Miki takes to social media to defend his human soul, she and Miko find themselves under attack.

1.title: FR - Devilman Crybaby - S01E10 - Crybaby
1.plot: Confronted by Akira, Ryo reveals the truth about demonkind and himself. Humans, demons and devilmen gather for an ultimate battle for the world.

meta.plot: A tragic murder sends a friend group into a frenzy, revealing hidden romances and betrayals lurking beneath the surface of their seemingly perfect lives.

1.title: EAR - Hard Broken [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Bloody Night
1.plot: The tragic murder of a young woman sends a friend group spiraling. Police comb through the crime scene but are unable to find a single piece of evidence.

1.title: EAR - Hard Broken [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Once upon a time
1.plot: A defiant holdout is brought in for police questioning, revealing secrets obscured by the seemingly perfect facade of Yasmine and Adam's marriage.

1.title: EAR - Hard Broken [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Unfaithful
1.plot: Saad takes the investigation into his own hands, leading him to uncover startling revelations that upend his understanding of Yasmine's murder.

1.title: EAR - Hard Broken [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Passcode
1.plot: The police continue collecting evidence. Youssef receives a visitor at the dental clinic and desperately tries to get a hold of Yasmine's secret phone.

1.title: EAR - Hard Broken [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Love on the 6th floor
1.plot: Saad makes a sacrifice for Adam. Flashbacks reveal a secret relationship at the heart of the murder mystery.

1.title: EAR - Hard Broken [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Better served cold
1.plot: The police arrive just in time to stop another killing. At last, the complicated truth behind Yasmine's death is revealed.

meta.plot: Beautiful executive assistant Zeina reluctantly teams up with the self-assured Tarek to chase down an elusive dollar bill worth $1 million.

1.title: EAR - Dollar [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: To promote its opening, a bank decides to circulate a dollar bill on the streets of Beirut and award $1 million to whoever ends up with it.

1.title: EAR - Dollar [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The fateful dollar bill winds up with a struggling young coffee vendor. Just as Tarek is about to get his hands on it, all hell breaks loose.

1.title: EAR - Dollar [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: After tracking the dollar bill down to wealthy misandrist Mrs. Lilianne, Zeina gets herself invited to Mrs. Lilianne's ladies-only party.

1.title: EAR - Dollar [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Tarek and Zeina quickly track down the magician from the party, but getting the dollar bill from him is much more of a challenge.

1.title: EAR - Dollar [MULTI-AUDIO-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5

1.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S01E10 - Episode 10

1.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S01E11 - Episode 11

1.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: The 7-day journey is nearing the end, and it's time for the final match. Who among the remaining two will be crowned winner?

2.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S02E01 - Episode 1

2.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S02E02 - Episode 2

2.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S02E03 - Episode 3

2.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: The arrival of a new inmate sparks talk about forming alliances or marking the inmate as the next target. Elsewhere, someone steps into the Devil's test.

2.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: In a match where alliances and strategy are crucial, a contestant disrupts the existing alliance, shaking the game's foundation and heightening tension.

2.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: New alliances form, yet some conceal their true intentions. As the game shifts, an unexpected elimination occurs, altering the dynamics.

2.title: FR - À l'épreuve du diable - S02E07 - Episode 7

meta.plot: It's the ultimate showdown of wits, brains, strategy, and alliances for a chance to win 500 million won.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E01 - Are You The Mole?
1.plot: Twelve crafty competitors gather in Australia's ancient Daintree Rainforest to begin the game, with no idea which of them might be plotting sabotage.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E02 - Take No Prisoners
1.plot: A puzzling jailbreak challenge ends in a nail-biting finish. The next day, the players face a new mind game that pits them against each other.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E03 - Knowledge Is Power
1.plot: The players have an opportunity to get to know each other better on a trip to the Great Barrier Reef, where they set out for a treasure hunt at sea.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E04 - Bank Heist
1.plot: One person makes a decision that shocks the others before an elimination with a surprise twist. During an Outback bank heist, some players melt down.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E05 - Human Lie Detector
1.plot: If three teams can move fast, a mail delivery mission could boost the prize pot. Lunch puts one player in the hot seat.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E06 - Mountain Mole
1.plot: A high-stakes climb through the Blue Mountains pushes the players physically and mentally, and begins to shift suspicion onto some new targets.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E07 - Spot the Fake
1.plot: The six players remaining after another elimination head to Sydney, where they'll need to spot subtle differences between genuine and fake.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E08 - The Bird Cage
1.plot: One person points fingers, but is it all misdirection? The players piece together clues and watch each other like hawks during a mission in Sydney.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E09 - Cold Hard Cash
1.plot: With the end in sight and no one left to trust, the four remaining players in the game bundle up for a grueling trek across the Snowy Mountains.

1.title: FR - Qui est la taupe ? - S01E10 - Who Is The Mole?
1.plot: The final three players go into stealth mode for the last mission before a quiz that will reveal the truth: Who is the winner, and who is The Mole?

meta.plot: A high-stakes competition series where twelve players work together in challenges to add money to a pot that only one of them will win at the end. Among the players is one person who has secretly been designated "the Mole" and tasked with sabotaging the group's money-making efforts. In the end, one player will outlast their competition and expose the Mole to win the prize pot.

This stranger-than-fiction series explores the question of whether Natalia Barnett is an exploited Ukrainian child with dwarfism or a dangerous adult masquerading as a child. Featuring exclusive bombshell interviews with members of Natalia's adoptive family, relatives, friends, legal experts, and neighbors, this docuseries offers a never-before-seen glimpse into the Barnett family, Natalia's identity, Michael Barnett's October 2022 trial, as well as key insights into new theories and evidence.

1.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S01E01 - Meet the Barnetts
1.plot: The Barnett’s adoption of Natalia, an allegedly six-year-old Ukrainian Orphan, turns into a nightmare when they learn she may not be six or Ukrainian. With suspicions mounting, the Barnetts discover they may have an adult stranger in their home.

1.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S01E02 - Orphan or Imposter?
1.plot: Michael Barnett reveals Natalia tried to poison and harm them as the Barnett’s own lies surface. This information leads to the question -- is there more than one villain here?

1.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S01E03 - Nightmare Neighbor
1.plot: Now re-aged as an adult and living alone, Natalia wreaks havoc at her new apartment by sexually propositioning and stalking the residents. Meanwhile, the Barnett’s truly sinister side emerges as they face a social services investigation into Natalia.

1.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S01E04 - Victim or Villain?
1.plot: The Barnetts, now divorced, abandon Natalia in an apartment in Lafayette, Indiana. With no food, a/c, electricity or phone, the police get involved. Despite Michael’s efforts to blame Kristine solely, his shocking confessions lead to their arrests.

1.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S01E05 - Barnett vs. Barnett
1.plot: As Michael’s trial approaches, he shifts fault to Kristine and catches a break when the judge throws out any discussion of Natalia’s age during the trial.

1.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S01E06 - Punch Or Be Punched
1.plot: Michael Barnett must face the consequences of his actions, and Kristine is next.

2.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S02E01 - Age, Rage & the Big Lie
2.plot: In a jaw-dropping premiere, Natalia attempts to fill the missing pieces of her life by learning the truth about her age. Meanwhile, shocking new information reveals that the Barnetts knew more about Natalia when they adopted her than they ever let on.

2.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S02E02 - For the Love of Money
2.plot: In an explosive confrontation, Natalia demands answers from Michael about why they adopted her. Law enforcement officials involved in the case answer questions about the Barnetts' true motivations behind adopting Natalia.

2.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S02E03 - By Any Means Necessary
2.plot: Natalia describes the horrible multi-pronged plot by the Barnetts to get rid of her. The Barnetts would try anything to get rid of Natalia, from having her re-aged as an adult to attempting to institutionalize her.

2.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S02E04 - Houses of Horror
2.plot: Natalia returns to the Barnett's home of horrors to confront the neighbor who abandoned her. Kristine's evil plan to eliminate Natalia now includes eliminating Michael as well. Natalia is preparing to confront Michael once more.

2.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S02E05 - Trauma Bond
2.plot: Natalia and Michael square off once more in a no-holds-barred brawl. Natalia wants more than just answers from Michael. She wants evidence and admissions about the assault she endured at the hands of Michael and Kristine.

2.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S02E06 - One Door Closes
2.plot: Natalia and Michael's argument comes to an unexpected and emotional end. Natalia discovers her permanent family as terrible secrets about her past in Ukraine emerge.

3.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S03E01 - It’s a Manses World
3.plot: Trapped by her adoptive parents, Natalia desperately seeks a way out.

3.title: FR - L'énigme Natalia Grace - S03E02 - The Rescue
3.plot: Natalia flees with the DePauls, terrified of her parents' impending wrath.

meta.plot: Featuring the boys of Johnny's West, a gang of zany transfer students are recruited for a mysterious mission ordained by their shadowy principal.

1.title: JP - Blazing Transfer Students [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Enter the Kakerus!!
1.plot: On his first day at his new school, Kakeru is thrown into a wrestling ring with six crazy students -- all of whom are also named Kakeru.

1.title: JP - Blazing Transfer Students [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Total Z!!
1.plot: For their first mission, Hikari and three of the Kakerus are transferred to a school that seems totally normal. Until lunch is served.

1.title: JP - Blazing Transfer Students [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Tearful V!!
1.plot: A spoiled brat has taken over this school, and it's up to the Kakerus to teach him a lesson ... by beating his mom in a volleyball match.

1.title: JP - Blazing Transfer Students [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Pretty Transfer Students!!
1.plot: The prettiest Kakerus don their best drag and transfer to a girls school. Their mission: to save a handsome boy kidnapped by some scary schoolgirls.

1.title: JP - Blazing Transfer Students [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Blazing Back in Time!!
1.plot: The Kakerus get sent back to the Edo period, where Kiriyama gets to use his samurai skills. Meanwhile, Hamada regrets never learning swordsmanship.

1.title: JP - Blazing Transfer Students [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Forbidden Service!!
1.plot: When pretty-boy Fujii gets recruited to a school for beautiful gentlemen, the two Kakerus he was with are ordered to get him back.

1.title: JP - Blazing Transfer Students [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Blazing Sports Festival!!
1.plot: The seven Kakerus are faced with a group of weirdos claiming to be the true Blazing Transfer Students. They're going to have to sort this out.

1.title: JP - Blazing Transfer Students [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Ultimate Blazing Transfer Student!!
1.plot: The seven Kakerus find out the real reason they were brought to this school, and uncover the true relationship between Hikari and the principal.

meta.plot: Tokunaga, a comedian who is down on his luck, has a shock encounter with Kamiya, an older comedian when he visits a fireworks event in Atami on a job. Tokunaga is deeply touched by Kamiya and asks if he can become his apprentice. Kamiya is a genius type of comedian who is full of human kindness. He accepts Tokunaga’s proposition on the condition that he will write his biography.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Struggling comedian Tokunaga meets intense senior comic Kamiya at a festival and asks to become his apprentice. Kamiya agrees on one condition.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Kamiya's comedy duo relocates to Tokyo, and he and Tokunaga grow closer. Meanwhile, Sparks gets their first shot at an audition to play a real venue.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Prospects for Sparks are looking better every day as New Year's approaches. Kamiya moves in with a woman named Maki, but his career is going nowhere.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Tokunaga and Yamashita juggle part-time jobs and comedy gigs, but when Yamashita is offered a movie role, they both have to think about their future.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Sparks and Ahondara perform in a variety show where the audience votes for the winner. After the results are announced, Tokunaga makes a change.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Sparks prepares for the first stand-alone show. Meanwhile, Kamiya's situation with Maki has grown precarious, and he asks Tokunaga for help.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Sparks goes from a radio gig to a spot on a TV comedy contest. Ahondara performs on the show, too, exposing the difference between their styles.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Tokunaga's TV appearances earn him a higher income; they also open a gap between him and Kamiya, whose debts and life are spiraling out of control.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Plans for a regular spot on a TV show fall through, making Sparks has-beens overnight. Tokunaga wants to keep going, but Yamashita has his own ideas.

1.title: JP - Hibana_ Spark [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: Sparks play one last farewell show and bring the house down. A year later, Tokunaga's real estate job is interrupted by news of Kamiya's return.

meta.plot: A jaded rom-com screenwriter in her 30s mines four love-sick women for their stories under the guise of providing them with romantic advice.

1.title: JP - The Many Faces of Ito [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - A: The Neglected Woman, Part 1
1.plot: After offering relationship advice at a promotional event, Rio Yazaki decides to dig deeper when she spots a common thread between four of the women.

1.title: JP - The Many Faces of Ito [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A: The Neglected Woman, Part 2
1.plot: Focusing on the beautiful sales associate Tomomi Shimahara, Rio Yazaki urges her to lend Ito money even after he neglects her and puts her down.

1.title: JP - The Many Faces of Ito [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - B: The Crustacean, Part 1
1.plot: The Ito described by the second woman Rio consults with is a self-centered, obliviously rude annoyance. Not unlike an up-and-coming writer Rio knows.

1.title: JP - The Many Faces of Ito [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - B: The Crustacean, Part 2
1.plot: Shuko's story connects perfectly with Tomomi's, much to TV producer Tamura's delight, making Rio even more hopeful for her screenplay.

1.title: JP - The Many Faces of Ito [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - C: The Lonely Woman, Part 1
1.plot: From the outside, pretty and popular Satoko's got the perfect life. But Rio detects a hidden loneliness, and she can't wait to dig deeper.

1.title: JP - The Many Faces of Ito [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - C: The Lonely Woman, Part 2
1.plot: Feeling insecure over her best friend Miki's relationship, Satoko decides to seduce Ito, putting her friendship in jeopardy.

1.title: JP - The Many Faces of Ito [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - D: The Educated Novice, Part 1
1.plot: After getting dumped by Ito, Miki calls up an old friend -- and it's none other than Rio's young rival, Kuzuken. But that's not the only coincidence.

1.title: JP - The Many Faces of Ito [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - D: The Educated Novice, Part 2
1.plot: Rio finally finds out who Ito really is, and she's repulsed. Moreover, Ito's written his own script, and it's dangerously similar to hers.

meta.plot: She's the most unlikely candidate to ever stumble into the role of a reporter, and she’s keeping everyone on their toes with her eccentric ways.

1.title: JP - Stay Tuned! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: HHTV's new hire Hanako Yukimaru tries hard but her endless goofs make trouble for her colleagues. Somehow, she manages to survive unscathed each time.

1.title: JP - Stay Tuned! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Meteorologist Fuyura wonders why his viewers ignore his near-perfect predictions. Hanako lends some unorthodoxly useful help to him and others.

1.title: JP - Stay Tuned! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Complaints from an advertiser spark a conflict between the news and sales departments. Hanako takes on a live reporting job, to Yamane's chagrin.

1.title: JP - Stay Tuned! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A rival station takes aim at HHTV, using dirty tactics to try to grind it into the ground. Hanako must fight or risk cancellation of her program.

1.title: JP - Stay Tuned! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The fight between HHTV and Higuma Television escalates and Hanako comes up with an idea to keep things fresh. She later hears from someone unexpected.

meta.plot: People bring their stories of missed lust connections to an objective panel of experts who then judge whether they could have gone all the way or not.

1.title: JP - The Could’ve-Gone-All-the-Way Committee [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - 1
1.plot: The true faces of the committee members are revealed as they listen to tales of unforgettable evenings with the opposite sex and pass judgement.
