meta.plot: Prince Lloyd wasn't always a prince...in fact, his previous life is one he remembers perfectly: he was a sorcerer, of sorts. So when he was forced to reincarnate, he decided to continue his studies, prince of the realm or no! But his new life has its own sets of challenges...including being a 10-year-old! What's the 7th prince/sorcerer to do?!

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Reincarnated as the Seventh Prince
1.plot: A mage, lacking both talent and lineage, is burned to death by the magic he loves. He's reborn as Lloyd, seventh prince of the Saloum Kingdom, with his past memories intact. One day, in a forbidden library, he awakens a demon that wields ancient magic...

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I Encountered an Adventurer
1.plot: After making the Demon Grimoire his familiar, Lloyd sets out in pursuit of a dungeon with magically enchanted items and encounters Tao, a martial artist who uses Qi techniques. Lloyd assumes the alter ego of Robert and heads deep into a dungeon with her.

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Like Qi Techniques and Enchantment Magic
1.plot: Deep within the dungeon lies a demonic lich that has laid many adventurers to rest. After forcing Robert to escape, Tao faces the threat alone, but is overwhelmed by the difference in power. However, just as the lich is about to finish her off...

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Headed Out for a Monster Hunt
1.plot: With an interest in weapon enchantments and their effectiveness, Lloyd joins Albert and Sylpha on a monster hunt. After meeting Tao and reaching their destination the group encounters a pack of bearwolves, who regenerate unnaturally quickly.

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Demon Is Angry
1.plot: Just when it seemed Sylpha was able to overpower the pack of bearwolves, the demon Pazuzu emits a miasma that has the knights collapsing to the ground. Once even Sylpha and Tao are rendered unable to retaliate, Lloyd finally makes his move.

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Sisters, Monsters, Spellbound Swords, and Brothers
1.plot: With his new bearwolf, Shiro, in tow, Lloyd visits his sister, Alieze, in order to learn how to communicate with monsters. Afterward Lloyd is reunited with another brother, Dian, a blacksmith who is seeking to create the ultimate Spellbound Sword.

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - I'm Going to Battle Some Assassins
1.plot: The kingdom has been infiltrated by a girl named Ren from the Assassin's Guild. Upon learning of her special ability as the Poison Blighted, Lloyd tracks her back to her hideout, sneaks in, and is attacked by a group of assassins with unique abilities.

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - I'm Going to Meet Jade
1.plot: Having formed a connection with the Assassin's Guild members, Lloyd's curiosity is captured by the leader Jade's teleportation ability. Lloyd and the others head to Lordost Manor, where the guild is happy to be reunited with Jade, until...

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Calamity Named Guisarme
1.plot: Ren is confronted by the demon lord Guisarme, who has stolen Jade's body and teleportation power. Guisarme is intent on seizing the bodies of the Assassin's Guild as well, when Lloyd arrives in the neck of time to defend them.

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Sylpha's Blade
1.plot: As Lloyd and Guisarme engage in fierce combat, the members of the Assassin's Guild are cornered by a horde of demons. Using the control of their abilities given to them by Lloyd's spell, the Guild resists, but are gradually overwhelmed by their enemies.

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Jade's Last Words
1.plot: Guisarme's teleportation-powered offensive barrage leaves Lloyd perplexed. Having come to a realization, he attempts a physical attack with a magic-absorbing sword named Spelltaker, aiming to decipher the nature of Jade's stolen power.

1.title: EN - I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Lloyd's Answer
1.plot: Guided by Jade's will, Lloyd deciphers the spell for teleportation. Pushed to the brink, Guisarme unleashes an attack powerful enough to reduce anything to oblivion, the Mortal Dark Sphere. At long last, this climactic magic battle comes to a conclusion.

meta.plot: Despite her supposed ineptitude with regular magic, Princess Anisphia defies the aristocracy’s expectations by developing “magicology,” a unique magical theory based on memories from her past life. One day, she witnesses the brilliant noblewoman Euphyllia unjustly stripped of her title as the kingdom’s next monarch. That’s when Anisphia concocts a plan to help Euphyllia regain her good name-which somehow involves them living together and researching magic!  Little do these two ladies know, however, that their chance encounter will alter not only their own futures, but those of the kingdom...and the entire world!

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Magical Revolution of the Princess and the Young Lady
1.plot: Anisphia, a princess who has retained her memories from her previous life, has spent her nights doing some kind of shady research to fulfill her dream of using magic to fly. One night, she takes a test flight with her special witch's broom, but crash-lands in the middle of the noble academy's soirée. There, she sees Prince Algard publicly breaking off his engagement with the duke's genius daughter, Euphyllia...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Acquisition of an Assistant for Both Profit and Pleasure
1.plot: After Euphyllia's engagement is annulled in front of her peers, Anisphia swoops in and carries her off. She returns to the palace and tells both girls's fathers that she wants Euphyllia to be her assistant, in hopes that it will restore the humiliated Euphyllia's honor. Thus the two of them begin to live together in a bizarre new arrangement...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Rainbow Magic Sword of Longing and Reminiscence
1.plot: Anisphia and Euphyllia have begun living together, but Euphyllia hasn't quite gotten used to her new environment, her new job, or her new position, and seems to simply be at the mercy of Anisphia. She seems a bit down, so Anisphia tells her she's making a special magic tool just for her.

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Princess and the Lost Child Announce Their Decision
1.plot: Euphyllia is sick with fatigue from dealing with her new and unfamiliar lifestyle, but with Anisphia's gentle nursing and warm words, she quickly recovers. Ilia tells Euphyllia about her own past and Anisphia's true intentions, finally giving Euphyllia an idea of who she should strive to be. But then an unexpected urgent message arrives from the adventurers' guild...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Magic Medicine and a Magic Sword Subjugate a Magic Dragon
1.plot: Anisphia struggles to face the dragon with only her magical tools and ingenuity, but its power is overwhelming on a scale unlike anything she's faced before. Eventually, Euphyllia cannot bear to watch her any longer...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Getting to the Truth of the Annulment and the Fascination
1.plot: After obtaining the dragon's magicite, Anisphia and Euphyllia visit Tilty, Anisphia's friend and research partner, in hopes of developing new technology with it. Anisphia is giddy with excitement, but then she receives word of the continuing investigation into the annulment of Euphyllia's engagement...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Magic Lecture of the Founder and the Assistant
1.plot: Lainie is now living in Anisphia's villa on probation, and to allow research on her power of fascination. Anisphia and Tilty begin to investigate Lainie's ability, and as Euphyllia watches their friendly banter, an uneasy feeling comes over her. Then Anisphia is informed that she's been summoned to give a speech before the Ministry of the Arcane, which disagrees with her research, and Euphyllia speaks up...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Magic Definition of the Monster and the Commoner
1.plot: Anisphia and Euphyllia have successfully completed their lecture before the Ministry of the Arcane. During the banquet held afterward, the alarm at Anisphia's villa sounds. Anisphia and Euphyllia rush back to the villa, but the sight awaiting them there is a heartbreaking one...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Sister and Brother, and for Whom the Crown Is Intended
1.plot: Euphyllia watches the battle between Anisphia and Algard grow increasingly intense as she frantically works to heal Lainie and Ilia. Anisphia struggles against Algard's new vampiric powers, but she makes up her mind to take her younger brother's life if it means stopping his evil deeds. The love- and hate-filled battle between brother and sister—prince and princess—nears its end...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Royal Succession of Resignation and Fury
1.plot: With Algard gone, Anisphia is the only one left to succeed the throne, so she begins acting as a future queen should. Euphyllia makes up her mind to support Anisphia as her assistant and subject, but when she sees the lab all cleaned up and Anisphia forcing herself to smile, her heart wavers...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Spirit Contract of Despair and Determination
1.plot: Meeting Lumi, a spirit contractor, has solidified Euphyllia's determination to be the next monarch. Her only wish is to preserve Anisphia's dream and her smile, but there is a hidden truth behind the spirit contract. When Anisphia learns what it is, she's unable to bear it and runs out into the icy rain...

1.title: EN - The Magical Revolution of the Reincarnated Princess and the Genius Young Lady [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Their Magical Revolution
1.plot: "I don't want to let you become queen." "I don't want to let you give up everything." While Ilia and Lainie watch with bated breath, Anisphia and Euphyllia confront each other, each with her own conviction. Each one cares too much for the other to back down. When Anisphia strikes with all her strength, Euphyllia strikes with all her soul. Who will win this duel?

meta.plot: For decades, the Galactic Empire has been locked in an interstellar war with the Free Planets Alliance, a conflict that involves thousands of spaceships and millions of soldiers on both sides. Two new commanders enter the conflict with great hopes: Imperial Admiral Reinhard von Lohengramm and the FPA's Yang Wen-Li. As they deal with superiors and subordinates, maneuver through complicated political arrangements, plot strategies, and win battles, each will be tested, and ultimately, changed, by the reality of war.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Into the Eternal Night
1.plot: January 1, 796 S.C. / 487 I.C.: in the Astarte star system, a 20 000 spaceships Imperial fleet under Reinhard von Lohengramm's command is about to be cornered by three Alliance fleets of 13 000 spaceships each. Against the advice of his subordinates, Reinhard decides to strike first in order to defeat each fleet before they can join. The Allied commanders, trusting the overall odds of 2 to 1, don't anticipate this and rebuff Yang Wen-li's advice to quickly regroup their forces.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Astarte Encounter
1.plot: After the destruction of the 4th and 6th fleets, Reinhard's fleet engages the 2nd Fleet. When its commander is wounded, Yang takes command and manages to escape utter destruction. In Phezzan, Adrian Rubinsky, administrator of the planet, and Nikola Boltik, his main adviser, make comments on the battle and note that it won't change the strategic situation.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Birth of the 13th Fleet
1.plot: In Heinessen (capital planet of the Free Planets Alliance), a memorial for the soldiers who died at the battle of Astarte is held. The warmongering speech of Job Trüniht, the Secretary of Defence, is interrupted by Jessica Edwards, whose fiancé was killed in the battle: she asks him why the advocates of war always sacrifice the lives of others while hiding in safer places. While going home, she is attacked by members of the Patriotic Knights Corps (P.K.C.), a nationalistic organization secretly led by Trüniht. She is rescued by her friends Yang and Dusty Attenborough and barely escapes death. The next day, Yang is promoted to rear admiral in command of the newly formed 13th Fleet. His mission: to take the Iserlohn fortress, a powerful space station which has repelled every attack.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Empire's Afterglow
1.plot: In Odin (capital planet of the Galactic Empire), Reinhard is promoted to imperial admiral after his victory at Astarte. With his friend Siegfried Kircheis, he pays a visit to his elder sister Annerose, the Emperor's favorite. In a flashback, Kircheis remember how he and Reinhard became friends, how Annerose was taken away from her home to be the Emperor's favorite and how they came to hate the high nobles and the Goldenbaum dynasty.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Kastrop Rebellion
1.plot: A new admiralty is created for Reinhard. He chooses commoners and lesser nobles to command his fleets: August Samuel Wahlen, Cornelius Lutz, Karl Gustav Kempf, Fritz Josef Bittenfeld, Ernest Mecklinger, Wolfgang Mittermeyer and Oskar von Reuenthal. Meanwhile, Maximilian von Kastrop has rebelled against the Empire. He thinks he is safe because of the "Artemis Necklace", a system of powerfully armed satellites built with the help of Phezzan. Reinhard sends a fleet under Kircheis' command to put an end to the rebellion. He manages to destroy the necklace. Kastrop is killed by his retainers and is the only casualty of the operation.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Rosen Ritter
1.plot: Yang decides to take Iserlohn by a ruse. The Rosen Ritter (Knights of the rose), a ground combat unit made of Imperial exiles, will pose as an imperial crew and infiltrate the fortress. Yang's staff is introduced: Murai, Patrichev, Fischer (a master of fleet maneuvers) and Frederica Greenhill, daughter of admiral Dwight Greenhill. The Iserlohn fleet is lured away from the fortress by decoys. When a damaged imperial spaceship asks for help, the commander of Iserlohn, who doesn't know where his fleet is due to radar jamming, authorizes it to dock...

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Iserlohn Invasion!
1.plot: May, 14, 796 S.C. / 487 I.C.: a fake imperial spaceship docks into Iserlohn. Walter von Schenkopp, commander of the Rosen Ritter, pretends to have important information and takes control of the center of command. The Iserlohn fleet comes back, only to be destroyed by the fortress' main weapon, the "Thor's Hammer". The fall of Iserlohn dramatically changes the strategic balance: Yang hopes it will lead to a peace treaty. Back in Heinessen, he wants to resign, but is promoted to vice-admiral instead.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Cold, Clear, Cybernetic Eyes
1.plot: Paul von Oberstein, chief of staff of the Iserlohn fleet, is in trouble. He saw through Yang's plan, but his commander didn't listen to him, and he fled before the destruction of the fleet. The three chiefs of the Imperial fleet resign, but want to make him responsible of the defeat. Oberstein meets Reinhard and explains how, like him, he hates the high nobles and the Goldenbaum dynasty, and offer his help. Reinhard agrees and obtains his pardon by advising the Emperor to refuse the chiefs' resignations.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Klopstock Incident
1.plot: Thirty years ago, marquis Klopstock was exiled form the imperial court. He asks prince Braunschweig, the Emperor's son-in-law, to ask forgiveness on his behalf. Braunschweig invites him to his daughter's birthday party. Klopstock's real goal is to bring a bomb in order to kill the Emperor, who will be there. At the party, Reinhard clashes with baron Flegel. The bomb is taken away by accident and makes little damage. Klopstock commits suicide and all the incident is kept secret.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Jessica's Struggle
1.plot: Yang is sent to Thernussen (Heinessen's second largest city) with his ward, Julian Minci, to attend a ceremony at the Military Academy. He meets Jessica Edwards, who is campaigning for the Peace Party candidate in an upcoming election. We learn that Yang, while being loyal to democracy, has no love for the current politicians. The P.K.C. sets a bomb in the Peace Party's headquarters, killing the candidate, but their plan backfires when Jessica, who is the new Peace Party candidate, wins a landslide victory.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - An Actress Exits
1.plot: Susanna von Benemünde, a former favorite of the Emperor, wants to get rid of Annerose and win back the Emperor's love. She teams up with Flegel, who hopes that a scandal involving Annerose will lead to Reinhard's downfall. Annerose is abducted: she is to be killed and found with a supposed lover from the lower class. She is rescued by Kircheis, Reuenthal, Mittermeyer and Oberstein. Benemünde is forced to commit suicide. Flegel has been smart enough to leave no proof of his involvement, but Oberstein and Reinhard suspect him anyway.

1.title: EN - Legend of the Galactic Heroes [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Attack on the Empire
1.plot: In the Free Planets Alliance, the capture of Iserlohn has intoxicated the public, the military and the politicians. It is possible to invade the Empire from Iserlohn, and many people think it's time to conclude the crusade against tyranny. In the High Council, Joan Lebello (Secretary of Treasure) and Hwan Lewi (Secretary of Human Resources) think it's better to sign a peace treaty because the economy in on the verge of collapsing, but the Chairman explains that they will lose the next election unless they achieve a substantial military victory, so the High Council decides to invade the Empire; only Trüniht sides with Lebello and Lewi. The invasion plan is drafted by commodore Andrew Fork, an ambitious man so sure of the righteousness of the war that he discards any objections, especially those made by Yang, as siding with the enemy. The Free Planet Alliance will send a force of 8 fleets, 30 million men and 200 000 spaceships under the command of admiral Lazar Lobos, with admiral Greenhill as second-in-command. Meanwhile, in Phezzan, Rubinsky warns the Imperial High Commissioner that the Free Planets Alliance is planning a full scale invasion of the Empire.

meta.plot: Cris Miró's journey as Argentina's first trans vedette in 1995, shedding light on the trans community. Despite challenges, she embraced her true self until her untimely passing, leaving a legacy of inspiration and acceptance

FR  - Fantasmas - S01E01 - Cookies and Spaghetti
1.plot: While ignoring his landlord's urgent letters, Julio obtains a gold oyster earring... then promptly loses it at the club. Later, Julio explains his sensitivity to shapes, colors, numbers, and the alphabet to his fellow rideshare passengers.

1.title: FR  - Fantasmas - S01E02 - Valued Customer
1.plot: While avoiding his housing debacle, Julio grows convinced that his lost oyster is the only way to prove his "mole" has grown.

1.title: FR  - Fantasmas - S01E03 - Toilets
1.plot: After learning of a program that would free his mind from his body, Julio gets a lead on the lost oyster from a bartender, who takes him to the former site of the first gay hamster club, and later, a middle school.

1.title: FR  - Fantasmas - S01E04 - Looking4Twinks2S**k
1.plot: After refusing to participate in a credit card commercial, Julio reluctantly accepts a new opportunity in a superhero franchise.

1.title: FR  - Fantasmas - S01E05 - The Little Ones
1.plot: Julio learns of a way to avoid getting proof of existence. Vanesja reflects on her life's purpose. Bibo pursues a new passion.

meta.plot: Julio Torres spins a fantastical tale of when he lost a gold oyster earring. In his search to find the precious object, Julio reflects on the offbeat characters he encounters in introspective, often eerie, and always comedic vignettes set in a dreamy, alternate version of New York City.

1.title: FR - Rebus [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A violent street attack is investigated by DS John Rebus and new detective Siobhan Clarke. However, it's John’s family that pose unexpected problems, along with an awkward affair.

1.title: FR - Rebus [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Hard-up Michael Rebus's rash act in Fife has bloody consequences for his brother John, who faces a fatal confrontation. Meanwhile, Siobhan finds out who stopped the street attack, and John confesses to contact with criminal Cafferty.

1.title: FR - Rebus [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: John's words come back to haunt him, while his brother abducts drug dealer Darryl Christie and recruits ex-army comrades for a risky raid. John hears his paralysed former partner's confession.

1.title: FR - Rebus [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: John is frustrated at family gatherings, unaware that the Cafferty and Christie rivalry is viciously escalating, with Michael at its heart.

1.title: FR - Rebus [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Lives are at stake, with John's loyalties torn and more revelations to come, while Rhona questions Chrissie, but home truths prove more dangerous.

meta.plot: Iconic character John Rebus is reimagined as a younger Detective Sergeant, drawn into a violent criminal conflict that turns personal when his brother Michael, a former soldier, crosses the line into criminality.

The story of Roman Compte, a Cuban exile and general manager of The Mutiny Hotel, the glamorous epicenter of the Miami cocaine scene of late '70s and early '80s. The Mutiny Hotel was Casablanca on cocaine.

1.title: FR - Hotel Cocaine [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - The Mutiny
1.plot: Roman Compte, general manager of Miami's wildly popular Mutiny Club, is forced by the DEA to spy on his estranged older brother Nestor Cabal, the city's biggest importer of cocaine.

1.title: FR - Hotel Cocaine [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - The Orishas
1.plot: Nestor rallies Roman to attempt a daring rescue of Chucho, Nestor's right-hand man, from a local hospital. But if Chucho wakes up from his coma, he'll reveal Roman's secrets.

meta.plot: In a present-day Spain, divided and on the brink of political chaos, inquisitive millennial investigative reporter Antonia stumbles on a decades-old conspiracy: the existence of a cryogenically frozen super-agent, García, created in a laboratory in the 1950s by General Franco’s fascist secret services. The old-world collides with the new as García and Antonia must learn to work together as they are drawn deeper and deeper into a political conspiracy that threatens to overthrow democracy and plunge Spain back into brutal dictatorship.

1.title: FR - ¡García! - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After receiving a mysterious package, aspiring journalist Antonia quickly finds herself embroiled in a deadly conflict tracing back to Franco’s dictatorship.

1.title: FR - ¡García! - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: While Antonia fights to be taken seriously – and fend off her attackers – Garcia searches for any trace of his former life.

1.title: FR - ¡García! - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Garcia tackles his first mission in over 60 years as a frustrated Antonia learns the truth about her father’s profession. Later, Garcia reunites with an important figure from his past.

1.title: FR - ¡García! - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: While mourning a devastating loss, Garcia is forced to flee – and reconsider everything he thought he knew about his former life. After learning more about her father’s past, a conflicted Antonia looks to set things right.

1.title: FR - ¡García! - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: After Ortiz’s plan lands Garcia behind bars, Antonia assembles a ragtag crew of freedom fighters to save him at any cost.

1.title: FR - ¡García! - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Antonia’s friends and estranged father team up to save her from a shared enemy, while Garcia enters a final fight for the future of Spain.

meta.plot: Tama, and Momo have adventures with other cats and dogs.

FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E01 - Angel Attack
1.plot: Shinji Ikari is summoned to Tokyo-3 by his estranged father Gendo, commander of the special agency NERV, to defend the city from a giant Angel by piloting the only weapon capable of battling the monster: Evangelion Unit-01.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E02 - The Beast
1.plot: Shinji wakes up in the hospital, with no memory of defeating the Angel the night before. Rejected by his father, Misato decides to take Shinji with her to live in her apartment. Later that night, memories of the battle against the Angel come flooding back to Shinji.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E03 - A Transfer
1.plot: Shinji begins attending his new school in Tokyo-3, and has a difficult time dealing with the fame of being an Evangelion pilot. Touji Suzuhara, who's little sister was injured in Shinji's fight against the Angel, is angry at Shinji. A new Angel appears, and Shinji must once again pilot EVA-01 to defeat it.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E04 - Hedgehog's Dilemma
1.plot: Misato is upset with Shinji for ignoring her orders in the last Angel battle, and he is so overcome by the stress of being an EVA pilot that he runs away. After wandering around Tokyo-3 for several days, Shinji is faced with the choice of quitting or staying in his new home.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E05 - Rei I
1.plot: EVA-00 is finally repaired, and Shinji tries to get to know its enigmatic pilot, Rei Ayanami, better. However, he is confounded because she is extremely insular, has no friends at all, and the entire record of her past has been erased. In the midst of this, a very powerful Angel, the floating monolith Ramiel, attacks Tokyo-3.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E06 - Rei II
1.plot: Continuing from the previous episode, the Angel Ramiel is drilling down into the GeoFront to attack NERV HQ directly. After Shinji barely survived a direct confrontation with it, Misato devises a plan to have EVA-00 and EVA-01 defeat the Angel by sniping it from a distance using a positronic rifle which requires the total electric output of Japan to power up.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E07 - A Human Work
1.plot: Ritsuko briefs Shinji on the real nature of Second Impact, the Angels, and the Evangelions' mission to defeat them. Misato and Ritsuko attend the public demonstration of a new Angel-fighting robot, Jet Alone, built by a rival defense contractor to NERV. However, the nuclear-powered robot quickly runs out of control, and Shinji must use EVA Unit 01 to load Misato onto Jet Alone so she can she can enter in its automatic shutdown code, before it melts down in a nuclear explosion.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E08 - Asuka Strikes!
1.plot: Misato brings Shinji, along with Touji and Kensuke, to a massive UN naval convoy transporting Evangelion Unit-02 and its fiery German pilot, Asuka Langley Souryuu, to Japan. Escorting Asuka is Misato's old boyfriend, Ryouji Kaji. After some awkward introductions and reunions, the fleet is attacked by a massive aquatic Angel. Asuka powers up Eva-02, and decides that she will defeat the Angel by playing "hopscotch"...

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E09 - Both of You, Dance Like You Want to Win!
1.plot: Asuka joins Shinji’s class at school, and moves in with Misato and him in their apartment. As Asuka adjusts to Japan (or rather, everyone else adapts to her...), a new Angel attacks which is capable of splitting itself into two identical copies. EVA-01 and EVA-02 are defeated, and NERV is publicly humiliated. With the Angel in a week-long regeneration period after an N² Mine attack by the JSSDF, Asuka and Shinji must learn to "synchronize" with each others movements combat, in order to defeat it once and for all.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E10 - Magma Diver
1.plot: The EVA pilots are disappointed to find out that they are not allowed to go on their class trip to Okinawa, because they have to stay at Tokyo-3 to stay on-call in case of an Angel attack. Meanwhile, a new Angel is discovered in a chrysalis-like developmental stage deep within the magma of the volcano Mount Asama.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E11 - The Day Tokyo-3 Stood Still
1.plot: Tokyo-3 comes to a standstill when sabotage knocks out all power, and the personnel must scramble to launch the EVAs manually when an Angel appears in the middle of the blackout.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E12 - She said, 'Don't make others suffer for your personal hatred.'
1.plot: Misato has been promoted to Major, but the celebration does not last long. A monstrous Angel appears in Earth orbit right when Gendo and Fuyutsuki are away, leaving her and the children to deal with a colossal kamikaze threatening to drop itself right on top of Tokyo-3.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E13 - Lilliputian Hitcher
1.plot: A routine test involving the EVA pilots turns into a struggle for survival when a wholly new type of Angel appears and spreads inside NERV HQ. This new, computer-like angel threatens to set off the self-destruct for the entire facility, leaving Dr. Ritsuko Akagi in a race against time to save the GeoFront and destroy the Angel.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E14 - Weaving A Story (1)
1.plot: In the first half of the episode, a clip show is presented to the Human Instrumentality Committee of Seele, reviewing the attacks of all Angels up to this point. The second part includes a poem in which Rei contemplates her own existence, and a cross-compatibility test between Rei's and Shinji's EVAs.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E15 - Those Women Longed for the Touch of Others' Lips, and Thus Invited Their Kisses.
1.plot: It seems like it's an important day for nearly everyone at NERV. Misato and Ritsuko are going to a wedding; Shinji and Gendo are visiting Yui's grave; Asuka has a date. However, important things will spring from these seemingly mundane events.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E16 - Splitting of the Breast
1.plot: Shinji beats Asuka in a synch test, much to her annoyance. Not too long after, the EVAs are dispatched to deal with a mysterious apparition, and EVA-01 is sucked into a shadowlike blackness that materializes out of nothingness from under it. While an emergency operation to rescue the captured EVA is concocted, Shinji goes on a trip into the depths of his own consciousness...

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E17 - Fourth Children
1.plot: A NERV branch in Nevada is obliterated in a catastrophic accident, and NERV headquarters prepares to station a new Evangelion in Japan. The Fourth Child is selected, unbeknownst to Shinji.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E18 - Ambivalence
1.plot: Evangelion Unit-03 arrives from the United States. However, its activation experiment brings out NERV's worst nightmare when it turns out to have been infected by the Thirteenth Angel. The other EVAs are dispatched to battle the Angel-infected abomination... even at the risk of killing its helpless pilot.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E19 - Introjection
1.plot: Enraged over Touji's near-death at the hands of his own EVA, Shinji refuses to pilot an Evangelion again and prepares to leave Tokyo-3 for good. He is forced to reconsider that decision when an immensely destructive new Angel attacks just as he is about to leave...

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E20 - Weaving A Story (2): Oral Stage
1.plot: Shinji achieved an unprecedented 400% synchronization ratio with EVA-01 during the battle with Zeruel, to horrible effect. With the EVA having ascended to the status of a living God and Shinji absorbed inside it, Ritsuko unsuccessfully attempts to recover him.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E21 - He Was Aware that He Was Still a Child.
1.plot: Kouzou Fuyutsuki is kidnapped and interrogated by Seele, who are horrified over the results of the last encounter with an Angel. He recounts his past, providing flashbacks into the creation of Nerv. The pasts of Misato Katsuragi, Ritsuko Akagi, Rei Ayanami and Yui Ikari are also revealed. Ryouji Kaji, meanwhile, decides to find out the truth, no matter the cost.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E22 - Don't Be.
1.plot: Asuka's synch rate is on a downward spiral after her defeat at the hands of the Fourteenth Angel, Zeruel, and her frustration with Rei, Shinji, Misato and Ryouji is on the rise. Angrier and more disturbed than ever, she is forced to relive her dark, traumatic past during the encounter with the Fifteenth Angel, Arael.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E23 - Rei III
1.plot: Asuka sinks into deep depression after Arael's mental probing, and is unable to pilot when the new Angel Armisael arrives. Armisael begins physically fusing with EVA-00 and threatens to do the same to EVA-01, prompting Rei to sacrifice herself to save Shinji, only to appear alive soon afterwards.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E24 - The Beginning and the End, or 'Knockin' on Heaven's Door'
1.plot: Too frightened to face Misato or Rei, Shinji runs away yet again, only to meet and strike a friendship with Kaworu Nagisa, the replacement pilot for EVA-02. Kaworu's openness and friendliness provide much-needed comfort for the disturbed Shinji. However, suspicions abound over Kaworu's incredible synchronization abilities.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E25 - Do You Love Me?
1.plot: Instrumentality has begun, and now its inner process, the joining of all souls into one, will be depicted. The episode is primarily driven by dialogue, the background usually complete darkness. White text often appears on a black screen, an omniscient voice questioning the characters.

1.title: FR - Neon Genesis Evangelion - S01E26 - Take Care of Yourself.
1.plot: Instrumentality continues. The focus is primarily on Shinji now, as he learns to accept the individual’s ability to shape their world, and how the self cannot exist without others to define it.

meta.plot: At the turn of the century, the Angels returned to Earth, seeking to wipe out humanity in an apocalyptic fury. Devastated, mankind's last remnants moved underground to wait for the day when the Angels would come back to finish the job. Fifteen years later, that day has come... but this time, humanity is ready to fight back with terrifying bio-mechanical weapons known as the Evangelions. Watch as Shinji, Rei, Asuka and the rest of the mysterious shadow agency Nerv battle to save earth from total annihilation.

The scientists of the μ(Mew) Project use DNA of endangered species to create a team of heroines imbued with amazing abilities. Armed with the skills of an Iriomote cat, Ichigo must band together with other Mew Mew girls to repel an alien incursion.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Wait, What?! I’m a Superhero Now?! Meow!
1.plot: Ichigo has a date with the most popular guy at school and couldn't be happier! Little does she know that her life is about to get a lot more complicated.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - What Makes a Real Friend?
1.plot: Tracking down the other magical girls feels like herding cats, but Ichigo is determined to find them! Will working at Café Mew Mew help her sniff out her allies?

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Stolen Kiss?! Mew Pudding is Here!
1.plot: A much-anticipated outing with Aoyama takes a turn for the dangerous when a mysterious new enemy boldly introduces himself to Ichigo.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Who Doesn't Want to Be Her? Our Last Member is a Huge Star!
1.plot: The Mew Mews found a new member, but getting close to her is no easy feat. They'll need to audition for a musical if they want to get anywhere near the intimidating Zakuro!

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Smile, Mint! A Fancy Lady, Forlorn
1.plot: Mint is used to getting what she wants, so when a person she respects rejects her offer, she feels a little blue. Fortunately, she has Ichigo and the others to cheer her up!

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Hear My Voice! I Will Surpass Myself
1.plot: Mint is determined to protect Zakuro from Kish, but with the team still missing its final member, keeping the fight away from Zakuro may be a losing battle!

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Farewell Cherry Blossom
1.plot: New players join the game, but are they better or worse than the impish Kish? Meanwhile, news of the Mew Mews has spread, and keeping secrets has never been tougher for them!

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Believe In Yourself - Romance on the High Seas
1.plot: Lettuce is convinced that the only thing she’s good at is being bad at everything! But a soiree on the high seas may provide Lettuce the opportunity to prove herself wrong.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Let Cupid's Arrow Fly! The Super Secret Date Scheme!
1.plot: Mew Aqua can turn the tide of battle against the Chimera Anima, but finding it won't be easy. What else isn't easy to find? Spare time to spend with Aoyama, in Ichigo’s case!

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Cat Got My Tongue?! A Heart-Pounding Transformation!
1.plot: A dangerous situation of epic proportions threatens thousands of civilians, but where the heck is Ichigo!? It's a race against time to find her and wipe out the alien threat!

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Everyone's Waiting For You! Run, Ichigo!
1.plot: Aliens have invaded, but Ichigo is nowhere to be found! Her friends have faith she'll appear and lend a hand, but will she come to their aid in time?

1.title: EN - Tokyo Mew Mew New [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Rain & Tears
1.plot: The fate of the world (and Ichigo's love life) depends on her finding precious Mew Aqua so she can clear both the air of Tokyo and the air between herself and Aoyama!

meta.plot: There is an estimated 70% or higher possibility that a magnitude 7.0 earthquake will occur in Tokyo in the next 30 years. In 2012, Mirai, a middle school freshman girl, goes to Tokyo’s artificial Odaiba Island for a robot exhibition with her brother Yuuki at the start of summer vacation. A powerful tremor registering 8.0 on the JMA scale emanates from an ocean trench, the famed Tokyo Tower and Rainbow Bridge crumble and fall, and the landscape of Tokyo changes in seconds. With the help of a motorcycle delivery woman named Mari who they meet on Odaiba, Mirai and Yuuki strive to head back to their Setagaya home in western Tokyo.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Odaiba Sinks
1.plot: Mirai Onosawa and her younger brother Yuki are visiting a robot exposition at Odaiba, Tokyo, when a massive earthquake strikes the city.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Broken World
1.plot: Mirai looks desperately for Yuki after the earthquake inside a colapsing building along Mari Kusanabe, a female motociclist courier who offered herself to help her.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Burning Bridge
1.plot: Mirai, Yuki and Mari decide to reach their homes together, but just after starting their journey, they find that there are far more dangers in the colapsing city than they imagined.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Their Promise
1.plot: Having finally left Odaiba, the trio find a place to gather supplies and prepare theirselves for their long walk, but after having a discussion, Mirai and Yuki stray from Mari and end up in serious trouble.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The School's Lament
1.plot: Mirai and company take shelter at her school's premises during the night, but their stay becomes far from peaceful as they are constantly plagued by aftershocks and depressed by the sight of those who lost their relatives to the earthquake.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Abandoning Choices
1.plot: The group reaches Mari's workplace, where she loses conciousness because of amenia. During that time the kids are suddenly frightened by Aya, a colleague of Mari, who noisily enters the building carrying a baseball bat.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Summer Evening Twilight
1.plot: Rescue robots fill the scene, fascinating Yūki and leading him to meet a new friend, who shares his interest and is the same age as Mirai. However the journey so far seems to have taken its toll on Yūki.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Pure White Morning
1.plot: Yūki collapses suddenly and is taken to the hospital, where Mirai agonizes over her brother's fate.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Goodbye to Today
1.plot: Mari finally reaches her home, only to find out that her house was destroyed and the fate of her mother and daughter remains unknown. Mirai and Yūki decides to help and discover that there is a near by elementry that is caring for the resident. On arrival Mari believes that two unknown bodies were those of her mother and daughter, thus mourning for a period of time. But Yūki, who believes that Mari mother and daughter are still alive, convince his sister to help look for them. Mari's daughter is discovered in a near by elementary school, that was also a shelter to the resident. Mari is reunited with her daughter, but still has no idea where her mother could have been. Mari discover her mother at a hospital and is reunited. Mirai, feeling happy for Mari, decides to leave with Yuki to go to their parents. Before leaving, Mirai writes a note to Mari thanking her for all that she has done for them.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Hey, Big Sister
1.plot: Mirai and Yūki are talking in the truck on the way back to their hometown, when Yuuki brings up the subject about his death. She tells him to stop talking about this nonsense, and that she and her parents would cry if he actually died. Once they arrive in their hometown, she sees Mayu, one of her friends from school. They chat, and Mayu tells her that her parents are staying in the nearby elementary school. Her dad is also being hospitalized due to an injury he sustained at work when the earthquake hit. She and Yuuki head over there, and find his best friend, Itsuki. By this time, Yūki has run off. He leads her to her parents, only to find out that her mom went back to the house to get clothing for her father. They walk outside again, and see the marronier that the two boys planted before she and Yūki went to the Odaiba Robotics Festival. Yūki is still nowhere in sight, so the two look for him.

1.title: EN - Tokyo Magnitude 8.0 [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - To Yuuki...
1.plot: Mirai "escorts" Yūki back home, and is reunited with her mother and father. One month later, Tokyo is well into recovery and reconstruction, but it is still clear that the city has been permanently changed. Mari visits Mirai, and returns her cell phone and Yūki's backpack. Mirai goes though her e-mail inbox, and finds a message from Yūki (sent from Mari's phone some time before he died) hoping that he can get a phone soon too so he can talk to his sister whenever they are not together. Mirai gives her mother the birthday present Yūki bought for her. In the end, Mirai, while watering the tree Yūki planted seen in episode 1, resolves to move on with her life, knowing that Yūki will always be in her heart. The ending credit montage shows life continuing in Tokyo.

meta.plot: Nervous to meet her new stepdad, Hiyori heads to the place she always feels at home—the ocean. When a curious girl named Koharu shows up, Hiyori decides to teach her how to fish, just like her father did before he died. But after Koharu reveals she’s also meeting her new family that night, the girls come to a startling realization. Their friendship is about to reach a whole new level!

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - A Very Unique Girl
1.plot: Hiyori likes to spend her times alone fly fishing. One day, a very energetic girl named Koharu tries to jump into the cold ocean in front of Hiyori and she stops her. This ends up being the beginning of their very unique relationship.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - If You Can Just Smile
1.plot: Koharu meets Hiyori's childhood friend Koi, who works at a fishing shop. Hiyori arranges a trip to a designated fly fishing location for Koharu.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Thank You
1.plot: Hiyori, Koharu, and Koi go on a fishing and camping trip with their families.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Aren't You Embarrassed?
1.plot: Koharu gets frustrated by Hiyori trying to help her so much as she's fishing and Koi celebrates her sixteenth birthday.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Together Again
1.plot: The girls go fishing on Ichika's boat and invite Futaba to come with them. Later, they all enjoy a nice meal at Hiyori and Koharu's house.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Difficult Is Fun
1.plot: The girls go on a boat to try to catch some dorados for the first time and meet one of Ichika's friends.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Wedding
1.plot: The girls work on summer homework and Futaba comes over. She's nervous about telling her friend that she likes fishing, so they come up with a plan to see if she should tell her friend or not. Later on, the girls go fly fishing at a mountain stream.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - I'm Fine Right Here
1.plot: Hiyori, Koharu, and Hinata go visit Hiyori's grandparents and the girls go fly fishing at a mountain stream.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - I Wanna Go on a Fishing and Camping Trip!
1.plot: Koharu tries to convince her dad to let her go on a fishing and camping trip with just Koharu and Koi, which causes a disagreement in the family, and results in Koharu and Hiyori running away from home.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - I'll Do My Best, Too
1.plot: Hiyori and Koharu get ready for their school's cultural fair and Hiyori goes fishing with Futaba.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Those Important to Me
1.plot: All of the girls finally go on their autumn fishing and camping trip, and Koi thinks back on the past.

1.title: EN - Slow Loop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Let's Pick Some Out Together
1.plot: Koharu's birthday is coming up and the girls try to figure out what to get her. Meanwhile, the girls learn how to tie some flies.

meta.plot: Iwakura Mitsumi, a tenacious country girl, prepares for high school in the big city. She meets the handsome Shima Sousuke, whose easygoing ways help her adapt in the real world.

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Sparkling-Fresh
1.plot: Mitsumi heads out for her entrance ceremony, confident that her day will be perfect, only to get lost. When she's panicking at the station, a boy wearing her school's uniform talks to her.

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Fidgeting and Wandering
1.plot: Heading into self-intros, Mitsumi is a nervous wreck. Nao-chan tries to ease her fears, but she makes a choice that she will end up regretting.

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Dreamy and Sparky
1.plot: Mitsumi heads to the student council office after school, where she finds Makoto standing frozen by the door.

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Tingling and Scraping
1.plot: Kanechika enlists Mitsumi’s help in getting Shima to join the drama club. He shows her a recording of an old TV show…

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Prickly and Giddy
1.plot: Mitsumi finds herself in the volleyball event for the class matches. Unathletic as she is, she asks Mika, who used to be on her school’s volleyball team, to help her practice.

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Drizzling and Flickering
1.plot: Fumi’s in love, but Mitsumi doesn’t have time to internalize it as exams are right around the corner!

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Hectic and Hot Stuff
1.plot: There's good news and bad news as Mitsumi and Narumi wonder how to cheer up a friend and Narumi's past is revealed.

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Heat and Complications
1.plot: Mitsumi and Sousuke head to the zoo, where they are shadowed by a couple of worrywarts.

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Drowsy and Peppy
1.plot: Summer break enters its latter half, and Mitsumi heads home to Ikajima. How does returning to her old stomping grounds affect her?

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Scrambling and Dripping
1.plot: Class 1-3 is putting on a play for the upcoming school festival, but Mitsumi is torn between helping out and her student council duties.

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Hype and Excitement
1.plot: The Tsubame West School Festival gets underway, and Mitsumi—surrounded by classmates being visited by friends and family—remembers that she’s a long way from home.

1.title: EN - Skip and Loafer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Shining
1.plot: It’s the second and final day of the school festival, and Mitsumi’s class gets some surprise visits from Sousuke’s family and friends.

meta.plot: Ayumu just fell in love at first sight with Urushi and joined the illegitimate Shogi Club! But Ayumu has vowed not to confess his feelings until he can best Urushi, and he has a long way to go before he can stand up to her strategic brilliance.

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - You Are Cute, Senpai
1.plot: Ayumu has an uphill battle ahead of him if he insists on beating Urushi in a shogi match before confessing to her. Especially since she already has her suspicions.

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I Want to Make You Happy, Senpai
1.plot: Urushi needs more members to officialize the shogi club. But she’ll have to survive Sport’s Day first!

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - I Want to Go on a First Date, Senpai
1.plot: Ayumu and Urushi are going to the school festival together. But it’s not a date—they’re just, uh, trying to recruit more members for their club! Yeah, that’s it!

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - I Want to Spend Time Together, Senpai
1.plot: It’s the end of the year, and that means Christmas is coming. If Ayumu makes the right moves, he and Urushi could actually make some progress.

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - I Want to Know More, Senpai
1.plot: A new year marks a new beginning and Urushi coincidentally runs into Ayumu when she’s out and about!

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - I Want to Get It From You, Senpai
1.plot: Valentine’s Day is here and that can only mean two things: chocolates and anxiety.

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - I Can’t Just Quit, Senpai
1.plot: A new challenger approaches!

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - It’s a Role I Refuse to Relinquish, Senpai
1.plot: The shogi club is now official, but Urushi realizes she must earn Rin’s respect. Meanwhile, Rin wants to know exactly what’s going on between Ayumu and Urushi.

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - I Want to Make Memories, Senpai
1.plot: Golden Week is here, and that means the shogi club can relax and have fun!

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - I Can’t Back Down, Senpai
1.plot: Tension is in the air when Ayumu meets Urushi’s father.

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - I Want to Get Stronger, Senpai
1.plot: Urushi’s thoughts drift towards a certain someone while she’s on a school trip. Meanwhile, Ayumu and Rin bond while practicing shogi.

1.title: EN - When Will Ayumu Make His Move? [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I Want to Win and Tell You How I Feel, Senpai
1.plot: Ayumu is determined to win a shogi match once Urushi returns from the school trip. But then Rin asks him an important question.

meta.plot: Wakana Gojo is a high school boy who wants to become a kashirashi--a master craftsman who makes traditional Japanese Hina dolls. Though he's gung-ho about the craft, he knows nothing about the latest trends, and has a hard time fitting in with his class. The popular kids--especially one girl, Marin Kitagawa--seem like they live in a completely different world. That all changes one day, when she shares an unexpected secret with him, and their completely different worlds collide.

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Someone Who Lives in the Exact Opposite World as Me
1.plot: Wakana Gojo is a high school student who dreams of becoming a kashirashi for hina dolls one day. Because his life is all about making hina dolls, he has a hard time fitting into his class because his interests are so different than anyone else’s. His classmate, Marin Kitagawa, is always at the center of attention and from another world. One day, they both end up on classroom cleaning duty and…

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Wanna Hurry Up, and Do It?
1.plot: After seeing how passionate Marin is about the things she loves, Wakana decides to help her with making outfits. He decides to help her out in making a cosplay for Shizuku Kuroe-tan from the game "Slippery Girls 2." They had planned to reconvene later to get the measurements started, but Marin couldn't wait and ends up coming to Wakana's house over the weekend.

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Then Why Don't We?
1.plot: Marin and Wakana start to grow closer as he helps her create her cosplay. Though he's happy about the fact that Marin treats him the same way at school as anywhere else, he also starts to worry about the fact that other people think it's weird that they're hanging out. Despite that, Marin takes Wakana shopping so they can look for materials needed for her cosplay.

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Are These Your Girlfriend's?
1.plot: Wakana felt relieved just for a moment after they got all of the materials they needed for Marin's cosplay, but then he's shocked to find out that he needs to finish the cosplay in two weeks. On top of that, his grandfather, Kaoru, hurts his back, so Wakana has to run the shop and he also has midterms. Wakana feels overwhelmed and gets depressed, wondering if he'll ever actually become a kashirashi at this point.

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - It's Probably Because This Is the Best Boob Bag Here
1.plot: Wakana finally completes the Shizuku cosplay. Marin is super excited that she gets to dress as her beloved Shizuku-tan and suggests that the two of them go to a cosplay event the next day. Even though it's her first time at a cosplay event, Marin gets requests for photos left and right. Wakana is overwhelmed with feelings as he watches over Marin, but...

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - For Real?!
1.plot: Marin and Wakana have a successful first cosplay event. Because of something Wakana said, Marin's mental and emotional state starts to change a little. Even though she was just spending time at the Gojos' home with Wakana and Kaoru to wash her outfit, she can't seem to calm down. Meanwhile, a certain person comes to Gojo Dolls after seeing the photos Marin posted onto social media of her Shizuku cosplay.

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Home Date With the Guy I Wuv Is the Best
1.plot: Marin is going to do a group cosplay with her idol, the cosplayer "Juju," whose real name is Sajuna Inui, and they're going to cosplay as Black Lobelia and Black Lily from the magical girl anime "Flower Girl Blaze!!". Wakana heads over to Marin's home so that he can borrow the "Blaze!!" DVDs for research to make the outfits for them.

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Backlighting Is the Best
1.plot: Juju's photographer and younger sister, Shinju Inui, meets Wakana and Marin for the first time. They're shocked at how opposite her appearance is to Sajuna, but they quickly become closer when they excitedly talk about cameras. Later on, Sajuna suggests that they check out the abandoned hospital that they'll be using for their group cosplay but...

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - A Lot Happened After I Saw That Photo
1.plot: Gojo is able to complete the Black Lobelia and Black Lily cosplays thanks to Marin's help. Both Marin and Sajuna try on their cosplays and they're both excited about how nicely they turned out, and Marin is even more excited about their upcoming group cosplay. When the day finally arrives, Marin and Sajuna get an unexpected visitor.

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - We've All Got Struggles
1.plot: Wakana and Shinju's secret plan was a success, which added to the success of their first group cosplay photoshoot. As Juju and Shinju look through the photos from the photoshoot, the sisters find out how they both feel. Meanwhile, Marin and Wakana are enjoying their summer vacation. They were preparing Marin's cosplay for a fighting game character named Veronica-tya, but then a problem arises...

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - I Am Currently at a Love Hotel
1.plot: ﻿Liz is a succubus who appears in one of Marin's favorite slice of life series, "SuccIDK." Marin had some interest in cosplaying Liz-kyun but didn't think she could pull it off until Wakana gave her a little push. With the cosplay ready, they head to a studio for a photoshoot, but the studio happened to be a rather unexpected location.

1.title: EN - My Dress-Up Darling [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - My Dress-Up Darling
1.plot: Summer vacation is coming to a close. Wakana received an SOS from Marin, who hadn't finished her homework, so he ended up helping her study at her house. They later realize that Marin had forgotten some math drills at school, so they go to get them. While alone at the school, Marin and Wakana make plans to go to a summer festival together. And when that day finally arrived...

meta.plot: On August 16, midway through a seemingly endless summer vacation, middle school third-year student Nagara, the mysterious transfer student Nozomi, and classmates such as Mizuho and Asakaze, are suddenly transported from their tranquil daily lives to a school adrift in an alternate dimension. They must survive with the super powers that have awakened within them.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Island at the Far End of Summer
1.plot: Midway through summer vacation, 36 students, some with newfound super-powers, find themselves all alone in their high school, adrift in a black void, unable to contact the outside world. Some students try to impose order, but are faced with opposition.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Aliens
1.plot: The students have relocated to a nearby island, where they have no shortage of food, and can get whatever they want through Mizuho's power. Suddenly, unexplained fires begin breaking out, and the hunt is on to find out who or what is causing them.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Cat Who Wore Sandals
1.plot: Nagara, Nozomi, Asakaze, and Rajdhani continue searching for new worlds. Students start going missing, and their bodies are found "frozen" into black shells, so Pony asks Mizuho to look into the matter. Mizuho reveals a surprise about her power to Nagara.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Great Monkey Baseball
1.plot: As the castaways swim in a mysterious sinkhole, they seem to be momentarily taken back home. Cap invites Nagara to practice baseball with him, leading to him telling about the Monkey League, and how its star pitcher, Blue, missed out on a perfect game.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Leaping Classrooms
1.plot: Nagara and friends use his power to survey new worlds in an effort to get back home. Meanwhile, the others students discuss the bombshell from Ms. Aki that some students were able to use their powers beforehand, and that may be what set them adrift.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Long Goodbye
1.plot: Nagara and Rajdhani arrive in a world called "Filmmaker," and discover a movie filmed entirely from Nagara's POV. Mizuho discovers a stray dog by the name of Yamabiko, claiming to be another castaway who attended the same school as the other students.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Road Book
1.plot: Having learned the truth about This World, groups led by Ms. Aki and Hoshi prepare to go their separate ways. Nagara finds himself in an upside-down world he cannot freely leave, and is forced to work on building a Tower of Babel that reaches downward.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Laughing Dog
1.plot: While traveling the wilderness, Mizuho asks Yamabiko how he became a dog. Yamabiko then relates how, 5000 years ago, he wandered different worlds all alone, until meeting a girl to whom he gradually opened his heart. But their happiness was short-lived.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - This Salmon Chazuke Is Missing Its Salmon Nya
1.plot: In a vast frozen waste, twins Sou and Seiji have been fighting each other for millennia. Ms. Aki says that to change the world, they need the twins' "Reverse" power, and Nagara and Mizuho come to assist. Yamabiko questions Sakura, one of Mizuho's cats.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Summer and the Demon
1.plot: Kossetsu reads the minds of others passing by in a train station world using her true power. She pines for Asakaze, knowing that he is interested in Nozomi, and that Nozomi is the only one who can change him. Asakaze is given a world-changing assignment.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Young Man and the Sea
1.plot: After learning of Nozomi's death from Kossetsu's letter, Nagara and Mizuho hold a memorial service for her. While advancing the project to return home, they are visited by an old friend, who tells them the story of when he met the man who invented death.

1.title: EN - Sonny Boy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - A Two-Year Recess
1.plot: Nagara attends the opening ceremony of his technical school, but feels out of place. He sees Mizuho leaving her all-girls' school, but she brushes him off. He recalls what happened after blasting off into space, questioning if he ever really went adrift.

meta.plot: A series of shorts that follows the humorous misadventures of Dug, the lovable dog from Disney and Pixar’s “Up.” Each short features everyday events that occur in Dug's backyard, all through the exciting (and slightly distorted) eyes of our favorite talking dog.

1.title: EN - Dug Days [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Squirrel!
1.plot: Dug comes face to face with his sworn enemy.

1.title: EN - Dug Days [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Puppies
1.plot: Dug learns that puppies are cute, but also a lot of work!

1.title: EN - Dug Days [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Smell
1.plot: Dug smells something he has never smelled before.

1.title: EN - Dug Days [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Flowers
1.plot: Dug finds out he doesn't love fireworks as much as Carl does.

1.title: EN - Dug Days [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Science
1.plot: Russell helps Dug find a new way to communicate with his "neighbors."

meta.plot: Al Wayne loves farming — and we don’t mean the video game sim. He wants to be a literal farmer, but in the process of improving his agriculture skills, he somehow winds up maxing out his overall character stats! He’s superpowered in the most unexpected of ways with abilities even the strongest of heroes would envy. Alas, all he wants is an idyllic farmer's life, but with demons and monsters invading the realm, Al may have to take up the mantle of hero just to keep his dreams from withering away!

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Top Notch Farmer
1.plot: All Al wants to do is live a tranquil existence as a farmer. Unfortunately for him, unwittingly rescuing the princess means his life is about to become far more complicated.

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Farmer and The Guild
1.plot: It was supposed to be a simple gathering quest, but Al’s discovery of a black dragon scale becomes an omen of things to come.

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Farmer and The Malevolent Dragon Ouroborus
1.plot: Al encounters the ghost of Helen’s brother, who begs him to save his sister from Ouroboros.

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Farmer and the Life That Was Saved
1.plot: Ouroboros won’t go down that easily; the battle for Helen’s soul has only just begun.

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Farmer and Lulugus
1.plot: A fellow adventurer joins Al on his way to Lurugus.

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Farmer and The Hero Who Can't Be a Hero
1.plot: Loki will stop at nothing to ensure the Hero’s bloodline ends with Ruri!

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Farmer and The Princess's Resolution
1.plot: Heavy is the head that wears the crown; Fal must accept a political marriage for the sake of the kingdom.

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Farmer and The Wedding
1.plot: Al, Helen, and Ruri must expose Nedilus’ evil deeds and thwart his plan! However, everything depends on rescuing a hostage imprisoned in the castle first.

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Al's Past
1.plot: Al had another childhood friend other than Testa, and her name was Ilvia. Al will always remember her.

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Farmer and Aspara Town
1.plot: Linea knows something is wrong in Gull Town and wants the guild to investigate.

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Reunion of The Farmer and The Demon King's Castle
1.plot: Al gets more than he bargains for when he rescues a young girl from her assailants; she’s the daughter of the Demon King, and she needs Al’s help to save demon kind!

1.title: EN - I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills. [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Farmer and The New Resolution
1.plot: Al’s mind reels from a shocking revelation! He has many questions, but he will only receive the answers if he accepts a dark bargain.

meta.plot:
A major incident has occurred in the peaceful Sky Land!? The young Princess Ellee has been kidnapped by the monsters of Underg Empire! A brave young girl, Sora, follows the princess through a mysterious hole. "TV"? "Cars"? Are those some kind of magic tools!?!?

But there's no time to be surprised! She has to get the princess back to the castle...! Flying between two worlds! The adventure with the Pretty Cure begins now!

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I'm a Hero Girl?! Cure Sky to the Rescue!
1.plot:
The infant princess Ellee-chan has been kidnapped by a monster!

A brave girl named Sora follows the kidnapper into a strange hole to save the princess, but when she finds a way out, she’s in another world?!

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A Hero in the House?!
1.plot: After defeating Ranborg, Mashiro takes Sora back to her home. Mashiro’s grandmother Yoyo does not appear surprised by their arrival and welcomes Sora and Ellee.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Hic-hic-homesick! Don't cry Ellee-chan!
1.plot: Ellee is in a bad mood. Sora and the others realize this is because she misses her Papa and Mama, so they decide to use the Mirror Pad to communicate with Skyland.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - I'm a Hero Gril Too! Cure Prism's Arrival!
1.plot: Kabaton sets a sneaky trap for Mashiro and the others. Sora’s Mirage Pen is stolen by Kabaton and she’s no longer able to transform into Cure Sky.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Hand in Hand! Our New Attack!
1.plot: Sora dreams that Prism is attacked by Ranborg. Tortured by her thoughts, Sora tells Mashiro, “I don’t want you to transform into a Precure” and tries to protect Ellee all by herself.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Tell me! Sora's True Feelings
1.plot: The new semester has begun, and Mashiro heads to school, but Sora can’t enter. While out on errands, Sora runs into Ageha, who guesses that she’s lonely because she’s not with Mashiro.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Thrilling! The Transfer Student Is A Hero Girl!!
1.plot: Sora is enrolled in the same school as Mashiro. However, she is worried she’ll accidentally tell everyone she’s from Skyland, so she tries not to stand out at school, but…

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Flightless Bird and the Strange Boy
1.plot: A strange boy enters the room and speaks to Ellee. It turns out he’s a boy named Tsubasa, a member of the Puni Bird Tribe. What is Tsubasa’s reason for not going home to Skyland?

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Wings of Courage, Fly Cure Wing!
1.plot: As the saucer-shaped Ranborg rampages above, Ellee is worried and flies out of the house to find Sky and Prism. Tsubasa chases after Ellee to protect her, but winds up getting captured by Ranborg.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Mmmm! What Does The Meal Of Your Memories Taste Like!?
1.plot: Sora and the others arrange a welcome party for Tsubasa. He says he wants to eat a dish from Skyland called “yakitai” but they struggle to make it taste like the original.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - An Awkward Duo!? Tsubasa and Ageha
1.plot: Ageha invites everyone on a trip to the mountains. They arrive at Mount Raso and join in a riddle-solving game, but Tsubasa is on the same team as Ageha and finds himself getting irritated by her antics…

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I'm Strongggg! Cure Sky VS Kabaton
EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Please Deliver It! The First Gift
1.plot: Sora and the others go to buy Ellee her first pair of shoes, and a lady lets them buy the ones she was planning on purchasing. Meanwhile, Yoyo succeeds in opening the tunnel to Skyland.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - To Sky Land! Reunion With That Person You Admire
1.plot: Sora returns to Skyland and reunites with Captain Shalala, the captain of the Azure Guards and the person she admires most, and becomes an apprentice member of the Guards. However, one of the apprentices doubts Sora’s skill.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - A Mega Ranborg Explosion? Protect Skyland!
1.plot: Skyland is continually attacked by Ranborgs. Sora and the Azure Guards defeat them, but Battamonda collects their energy and puts Skyland into a crisis.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Elleetaro Squad Defeats the Ogre!
1.plot: Sora and the gang return to Sorashido City to see Yoyo. The King and Queen are under a curse, and Ellee is feeling sad. Ageha proposes a Puppet Play to cheer her up.

EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Exciting! The Best Nursery School Teacher, Cure Butterfly
1.plot: During her practicum at the nursery school, the children find out Ageha is friends with the Precures. But one of the children, Takeru, disagrees on what it is to be a Precure, and runs outside.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Ageha and Tsubasa Get Colorfully Excited!
1.plot: Ageha begins living at Mashiro’s house and makes herself busy cooking and cleaning for Sora and the gang. Tsubasa worries Ageha is wearing herself out, and Ageha makes a special request to Tsubasa.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - The First Step Towards Mashiro's Dream
1.plot: Ageha's co-worker and art school student Natsumi suggests that Mashiro enters the “Everyone’s Picture Book” contest. Sora and the gang encourage her, and she decides to try making a picture book.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Soar! Wings of Knowledge
1.plot: Yoyo invites everyone on an outing to the mountain highlands. There, Yoyo has a vegetable garden growing, and Tsubasa is surprised at how much Yoyo knows about vegetables.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Battamonda's Final Strategy
1.plot: In Skyland, many people are spotting a woman in a blue cape, just like Captain Shalala. While out shopping with everyone, Sora spots a woman in a blue cape too and chases after her.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Broken Dreams and Renewed Strength!
1.plot: A discouraged Sora returns to Skyland and reunites with her family. Meanwhile, the Ranborg containing Captain Shalala appears in Sorashido City. Mashiro and the others take it on without Sora.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Sparkling Morning Star, Ellee-chan's Secret
EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - Fun! The Princess Goes to the Zoo!
1.plot: After being asked by the King and Queen to care for Ellee, Sora and the others return with her to Sorashido City, where they visit Sorashido Nature Park to see the animals. However, they also encounter a new underling from the Undergu Empire.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E26 - Take off! Memories Connected by Airplanes
1.plot: Mashiro’s parents are finally returning from overseas for a visit, so Sora and the gang go to the airport to pick them up. While exploring the airport, they meet a girl named Shoko who knows a lot about airplanes.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E27 - A Wild Lesson in the Mirror Pad?!
1.plot: Sora and the gang get sucked into the Mirror Pad by a vortex. Inside the Mirror Pad is a special stage where they are made to do “special training.”

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E28 - Ageha's Exciting Fashion Show!
EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E29 - Sora and the Missing Stuffed Animal
1.plot: In an abandoned European-style house at the edge of town, Sora is surprised when a stuffed animal talks to her. Although Sora is scared when it follows her home, she begins to feel like there is some reason for the situation and decides to help.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E30 - Soaring Sea! Beach Paradise
1.plot: To wrap up their summer holiday, everyone goes to the beach, but Sora doesn’t know how to swim and she nearly drowns. Everyone tries to teach her how to swim but she has trouble getting the hang of it, until…

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E31 - A New Threat! Rescue Ellee-chan!
1.plot: In order to improve Ellee’s mood, Sora and the gang visit the Sorashido Photo Studio. Everyone enjoys the photo shoot, but on the way home a strange man in a black hooded cloak appears and takes Ellee.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E32 - Big Transformation! Cure Majesty!
1.plot:
Ellee says she is Cure Majesty, but she still can’t transform at will. Meanwhile, Minoton

re-appears, but this time he has been brainwashed with Undergu Energy.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E33 - Ultimate Power! Majestic Chroniclon
1.plot: Yoyo summons Sora and the gang to Skyland, where they explore a ruin that suddenly appeared. In the depths is a book called “Majectic Chroniclon” that contains the Ultimate Power.

1.title: EN - Soaring Sky! Pretty Cure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E34 - Mon-mon! Mashiro and His Return!
1.plot: After losing to the Precures, Battamonda is now living in Sorashido City, calling himself “Monda.” He disguises himself as an art school student, and approaches Mashiro, who has lost her confidence…
