In 1977, Daisy Jones & The Six were on top of the world. Fronted by two charismatic lead singers — Daisy Jones and Billy Dunne — the band had risen from obscurity to fame. And then, after a sold-out show at Chicago's Soldier Field, they called it quits. Now, decades later, the band members finally agree to reveal the truth.

1.title: FR - Daisy Jones And the Six - S01E01 - Track 1: Come and Get It
1.plot: Daisy Jones is a disaffected teenager who finds meaning in the Sunset Strip rock scene. In suburban Pennsylvania, Billy Dunne, his brother Graham, and their best friends Eddie and Warren form a band, desperate to escape their surroundings. When Billy and Daisy meet, her talent and his ambition will combine to change all of their lives, for better and worse. This is the story of what happened.

1.plot: Having found her voice, Daisy navigates the LA music scene–with the guidance of her close friend Simone and legendary producer Teddy Price. After a chance encounter with Teddy offers hope, the band is heartbroken to find Billy’s demons threatening to overpower his potential.

Meanwhile Daisy finds it far more difficult to write music when there are expectations. When Billy writes a new song, Teddy realizes that a collaboration between the two songwriters might just be the answer to all of their problems.

Meanwhile, Graham wrestles with whether to profess his feelings for Karen at a house party in the Canyon, knowing that a wrong move could threaten the survival of the band.

However, when Billy and Daisy prove unwilling to collaborate on each other’s material, they have no choice but to try and write something from the ground up together. This proves more challenging than either expected. Meanwhile, Karen sees a new side of Graham during a beach trip.

2.plot: William Wisting and his team are hit hard when a crime scene inspection with serial killer Tom Kerr goes horribly wrong. Wisting's daughter Line now has to deal with the consequences of her documentary causing it all.

2.title: FR - Wisting - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Wisting tries to gather the team after the tragedy that has befallen them.  He is forced to cooperate with Kripos investigator Stiller in the hunt for the mysterious helper.

2.title: FR - Wisting - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: A new disappearance makes Wisting and Stiller fear that the killers are about to flee the country.  But has the new victim really been kidnapped?  A new clue causes the police to arrest a suspect.

2.title: FR - Wisting - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Line's shocking findings overturn the police's theory of "The Other".  The perpetrator gets rid of loose threads and time is running out.  Wisting discovers the secret that his daughter has kept hidden from him.

3.title: FR - Wisting - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: Wisting and his team are warned about a cruel crime scene in Larvik. The severed head of a young asylum seeker is found on a stake in the middle of the square. FBI agent Maggie Griffin returns to assist in the case.

3.title: FR - Wisting - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: When a corpse appears in the net of a local poacher, the two killings are linked. Line suspects that Wisting has had a relationship with the manager at the care center.

3.title: FR - Wisting - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Maggie is forced to share information, which she has previously kept secret from Wisting. The investigation takes a whole new turn, and leads Wisting and Maggie on a new hunt across the border into Sweden.

3.title: FR - Wisting - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: In Sweden, Wisting and Maggie find a former victim. Together with the Swedish police, they are drawn into a fierce police action, and the final settlement is both intense and surprising.

meta.plot: The misadventures of a knight and a healer begin in this new fantasy comedy series!

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - In this world where monsters are rampant...
1.plot: A knight and a foul-mouthed healer meet and are going to have a hard time together!

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Forced to travel with Carla, a healer...
1.plot: ...Alvin resumes his original quest to gather antidote herbs, but on the way he ends up getting attacked in a graveyard by ghosts which they manage to escape unexpectedly, but then he falls into a trap set by goblins and basically the first half of the episode is filled with great suffering but Carla's curse is still in effect so he can't get away from her and there's even more suffering in store nevertheless and anyway these titles are really long and kind of serve double-duty as next episode previews and we're pretty curious about how many people actually listen to the whole thing and that's the deal with episode 2.

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Despite the terrible time he's been having...
1.plot: While trying to demonstrate their skills, Alvin and Carla encounter a delicious and dangerous enemy.

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The first dungeon Alvin tackles with Carla is designed for...
1.plot: Just when Alvin and Carla are about to face their first dungeon experience, it turns out to be pure beginner's fun and so even Alvin is convinced that he can master it in no time.

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The owner of the inn they visit seems very nice, but...
1.plot: After leaving the dungeon, Alvin and Carla go to rest at an inn, but the healer doesn't seem to like the establishment or the attendant very much. Then they meet a somewhat suspicious old lady.

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - As usual, Alvin and Carla have to overcome a series of crises...
1.plot: Rejuvenated, the witch gives Alvin and Carla the herbs they need. The two leave for the guild and obviously have another problem.

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - This show is fairly unique in that Carla is the only recurring female character...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla decide to help a zombie get his revenge by confronting a powerful necromancer.

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Thanks to Altargaia (reminder: this is the mushroom's name)...
1.plot: Released from prison, Alvin reunites with Carla, who has decided to help Maria summon a particular soul.

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - This Episode Features Even More Female Guest Characters Hot on the Heels...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla meet in the forest the Medusa and Dryad. What are they planning to do with them?

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - In the second half of this episode, we enter the "What Story Is This?" arc...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla visit the adventurers' guild and meet an old companion of Alvin's there, who isn't particularly fond of our party...

1.title: EN - Don't Hurt Me, My Healer! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - So, this is Part 2 of the "What Story Is This?" arc...
1.plot: Alvin once again finds himself in an awkward position from which he cannot free himself. Can Carla help him this time, or is she just making it worse?

meta.plot: An ordinary office worker is reincarnated as Leon into a particularly punishing dating sim video game, where women reign supreme and only beautiful men have a seat at the table. But Leon has a secret weapon: he remembers everything from his past life, which includes a complete playthrough of the very game in which he is now trapped. Watch Leon spark a revolution to change this new world in order to fulfill his ultimate desire...of living a quiet, easy life in the countryside!

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Hate This World
1.plot: Leon is reincarnated in the world of the "otome game" he was playing as the third son of an impoverished baron. While he's trying to find happiness as a "mob" or background character, he's offered a terrible marriage proposal.

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Hey, Girl. Wanna Get Some Tea?
1.plot: Leon officially begins attending the academy. Though the romantic interests he saw in the game are present, for some reason the girl with them is not the protagonist of the otome game, but a girl he doesn't recognize. Leon feels there is something off about the situation...

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Let's Duel, Prince
1.plot: Marie is being bullied by Angelica's followers. Because events don't match what happened in the otome game, Leon attempts to gather information on Marie.

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Mind If I Go Easy on You?
1.plot: Leon's Armor Arroganz is mocked for being old fashioned, and the weapon Luxion has prepared for him is... a shovel! The audience ridicules Leon, but will he be able to defeat his five opponents?!

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - It's Awesome
1.plot: Leon's duel against Julius and his kingdom's best Armor begins. Why does Julius choose Marie over Angelica? His feelings drive him to attack Leon...!

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - A Cultural Festival? It'll Be My First
1.plot: Leon and his friends open a cafe at the school festival. However, Julius' posse open their own cafe, and a mysterious girl trying to get close to Leon appears before Olivia. It looks like there's trouble ahead at this school festival...!

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - We Both Hate Hot Guys
1.plot: Jilk appears in the bike race held on the final day of the academy festival. However, he is obstructed by the followers of his ex-fiancee and is badly injured. The situation develops further, and Leon finds himself dragged into it...

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - This Isn't a Game
1.plot: Olivia finds herself pushed into a corner by Stephanie. Meanwhile, while understanding Olivia should resolve the pirate hunting situation, he chooses to prioritize efficiency and gets involved.

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - She's a Doormat
1.plot: Leon's attempt to support Olivia backfires. He attempts to clearly define their relationship as one between mob and protagonist, but... Meanwhile, during a sword fight against Brad, he realizes the difference in their resolve.

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Unlike You Wannabe Nobles
1.plot: The school trip begins, and Leon heads to the southern island where the item he seeks can be found. Once there, he runs into Angelica and Olivia at a shrine dedicated to marriage while things are still awkward between them.

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - What I Can Do Now
1.plot: Leon weaves his way through the horde of monsters alone in order to rescue Angelica. Meanwhile, Chris and Olivia battle fiercely alongside the other students on the passenger ship, but they're surrounded by the duchy's fleet...!

1.title: EN - Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - No Matter How Tough the World of Otome Games Is
1.plot: Forced to face off against the Black Knight, Leon, through cunning tactics, manages to defeat his formidable opponent and bring the enemy forces to his mercy. This act gains him more fame and notoriety with the Holfort Kingdom, and he is appointed as Viscount.

meta.plot: In his past life, he was known as Demon Lord Varvatos, an all-powerful magic user and ruler. But he was lonely after the loss of his friends and loved ones during his rise to power, so in his dying moments, Varvatos cast a reincarnation spell so that he'd get a second chance at just being a normal guy. At first it looks like that's going to work – he's reborn thousands of years later as villager Ard. Unfortunately for him, his memories are still intact and he's not aware just how much has been lost over the time he spent not existing, and it looks like that's going to cost him his normal life.

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Typical Nobody
1.plot: Due to the isolation caused by his strength, the Demon Lord Varvatos longed for a normal life, and after several thousand years he reincarnated as the villager, Ard Meteor. His dream is to forge bonds of friendship with other humans. However, even after turning 10 he still had yet to achieve his goal. During that time he has a fateful encounter with a young girl fighting monsters in the forest.

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Non-Standard
1.plot: Though he joined the magic academy, what awaited him was far from a normal life. Without realizing it Ard had already grown famous and he was quickly put on a pedestal by his peers. Then there was another problem within his class - the young girl, Ginny, a succubus, was being abused by Elraldo, a noble's son. Ireena then intervenes and Elraldo insults her. When Ard demands an apology, he is challenged to a duel instead.

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Demon Lord's Play
1.plot: The Headmaster begs Ard to participate in the upcoming battle event, and he struggles to decide since the risk is great whether he accepts or refuses. During that time Ginny invites him out on a date. Ireena butts in, but Ginny quickly approves her coming too. Ireena tries to be even more considerate after that, so Ginny speaks of her true ambition. Then on the day of their date, the three run into a suspicious group of people.

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Duel
1.plot: Ireena finds herself constantly irritated at Ard's popularity. While Ard is trying to think of a way to soothe her, Ginny appears before him in an enticing outfit. While Ginny makes her approach using her Charming Evil Eye, Ireena also presses him with a bold outfit of her own. The two are about to explode at each other over Ard and they nearly start a duel when...?!

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Story of a Lonely King
1.plot: Elzard is planning to use Ireena as a sacrifice to revive the evil gods and destroy the world. Yet why was Ireena chosen as a sacrifice? Ard appears before Elzard with new weapons in hand to rescue Ireena as Demons stand in his way. When Ireena's hidden secret is revealed, how will Ard react...?

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Raging Champion
1.plot: The Demon Lord's companion, Sylphy, reappears in the modern world after several thousand years. A masked man tells Sylphy where she can find the Demon Lord and she... Meanwhile, the Magic Academy is preparing for its school festival, and Ard is asked to perform in a play in lieu of their Sword King Battle Tournament while also dealing with a threat to cancel the festival. Ard and the others start discussing the play when they're interrupted by a huge commotion at the school.

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Exciting Festival
1.plot: The school festival is here and Ard is busy patrolling with Ireena. However, Ard is left cradling his head after Olivia acted on her own to enter him into the Sword King Battle Tournament and Ginny forces him to be waited on at their class's Erotic Maid Cafe. Meanwhile, Ireena, Ginny, and Sylphy also decide to enter the Sword King Battle Tournament. In Sylphy's case, it's due to her strong attachment to the tournament's grand prize.

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Mask Laughs
1.plot: The play serving as a main event for the festival is starting up. Ard is playing the role of the Demon Lord while Sylphy performs as the Evil God, making Ard suddenly recall his battle against said god. At the time, Sylphy was struggling with a sense of inferiority and the feeling that Lydia didn't need her. Yet when Varvatos reveals Lydia's true feelings and gives Sylphy permission to fight freely, Sylphy pulls off something incredulous...

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - According to a God
1.plot: On their way to the class field trip, a mysterious young boy claiming to be a god appears before Ard, Ireena, and Ginny. After making a mysterious request, the god sends the three of them back into the ancient era when Varvatos was active. After deciding to try and gain an audience with Varvatos in order to change their situation, they encounter a woman fighting monsters in a field. Then a figure they all know very well appears before them...

1.title: EN - The Greatest Demon Lord Is Reborn as a Typical Nobody [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - To the Battlefield of Old
1.plot: Ard is feeling guilty as they stay in Lydia's villa while awaiting their deployment. Before he can shake those feelings the battle against the demons begins and Ard's group is left in charge of logistics. Ard recalls that there wasn't any major trouble in this battle, but the demon appears before them in the rear. So in order to earn their meeting with the Demon Lord, Ard...

meta.plot: Centaurworld follows a war horse who is transported from her embattled world to a strange land inhabited by silly, singing centaurs of all species, shapes, and sizes. Desperate to return home, she befriends a group of these magical creatures and embarks on a journey that will test her more than any battle she's ever faced before.

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Hello Rainbow Road
1.plot: Separated from her Rider during battle, Horse wakes up in a colorful world filled with strange beasts. But where is her trusty friend?

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Fragile Things
1.plot: The herd sets out to find the way home. Wammawink encourages them to be careful and take it slow, but fearless Horse charges ahead.

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Key
1.plot: Horse meets Waterbaby — one of Centaurworld's shamans — and learns about the key: a mysterious object that could reunite her with Rider.

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - What You Need
1.plot: Searching for the next piece of the key, Horse leads the herd into a mysterious forest to see the tree shamans. They grant wishes — but there's a catch.

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - It's Hidin' Time
1.plot: The friends seek shelter in a cave during a storm... but they're not alone. While looking for an exit, they discover strange paintings on the walls.

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Holes: Part 2
1.plot: The group follows the Rainbow Road into a deep, dark hole, where a Moletaur locks them in jail and informs them that they'll face the judge.

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Johnny Teatime's Be Best Competition: A Quest for the Sash
1.plot: Zulius brings the herd to Cataur Valley, where the shaman is fuzzy but fierce. To earn a piece of the key, Horse goes glam for a silly competition.

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Ride the Whaletaur Shaman!
1.plot: Horse hopes to find the final shaman in Merfolk Town. But she's growing discouraged — and looking more and more like a centaur every day.

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Rift (1)
1.plot: The herd makes it to the Rift and reminisces about their time together while waiting for Waterbaby to arrive with the final piece of the key.

1.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Rift (2)
1.plot: Horse and Rider face a frightening enemy. Back in Centaurworld, the herd summons up the courage to enter the void and fight for their friend.

2.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Horsatia Wighair Beansz?
2.plot: Horse tries to recruit an army to defend Centaurworld, but no one wants to join. The herd visits the Horsetaurs' castle to see if they'll help.

2.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - All Herd All the Terd
2.plot: Up in their cloud condo complex, the Birdtaurs have been obsessively watching the herd: Horse and friends are their favorite reality stars!

2.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - My Tummy, Your Hurts
2.plot: Horse tries to enlist the fierce Coldtaurs in her battle — but they capture Glendale! Back in the human world, Waterbaby sends a message to Rider.

2.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Holes: Part 3
2.plot: On a trip to the Underground Kingdom, Horse learns that Rider has a magnificent new horse named Becky Apples. Would Rider really replace her?

2.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Bunch O' Scrunch
2.plot: Horse discovers a powerful ability: She can jump into backstories! And seeing the tough times her herd friends faced helps her feel less alone.

2.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - The Ballad of Becky Apples
2.plot: Rider defies the general's orders and goes to the Nowhere King's castle to get the artifact. But her new horse, Becky Apples, isn't exactly cooperative.

2.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - The Hootenanny
2.plot: All of Centaurworld's residents gather for the hootenanny. But can Horse turn this colorful collection of creatures into a fearless army?

2.title: EN - Centaurworld [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - The Last Lullably
2.plot: Horse leaps into the Nowhere King's mind and learns his haunting backstory. Meanwhile, Rider and the herd come up with a plan.

meta.plot: At Super Hero High, iconic Super Heroes like Wonder Woman, Supergirl, Batgirl, Harley Quinn, Bumblebee, Poison Ivy, and Katana navigate all the twists and turns of high school. United by friendship, the DC Super Hero Girls empower kids to shine with confidence and courage, especially while they combat those overwhelming, exciting, and awesomely awkward moments of growing up (sometimes super powers can be super stressful!).

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Welcome to Super Hero High
1.plot: It’s the start of a brand new year at Super Hero High School!!! Follow your favorite DC Super Hero Girls as they experience the ups, downs and all-arounds on their first day of school.

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - All About Super Hero High
1.plot: It’s a big day for everyone at Super Hero High School! Wonder Woman has finally touched down on campus and she’s ready to make her mark, but she still has a lot to learn.

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Roomies
1.plot: Meeting new friends is really exciting, but living with them can get really messy! Find out which two Super Heroes end up as roommates.

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Crazy Quiltin'
1.plot: It's time for the first project of the year! Bust out your pencils and help Wonder Woman design a Super Suit that'll bring out her true colors in the halls of Super Hero High School.

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Power Outage
1.plot: It’s time for the girls to test their super power skills! Find out who passes with flying colors and who doesn’t at Super Hero High School. The answer might surprise you.

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Fall Into Super Hero High
1.plot: Harley Quinn has organized a movie night, premiering a compilation of footage starring the girls, but what will the others think of it?

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Hero of the Month: Poison Ivy
1.plot: Let's hear it for Our Hero of the Month at Super Hero High: Poison Ivy! Not only has she rescued classmates, friends and strangers, but you'll be amazed at how many sticky situations she's stopped from getting worse!

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Designing Disaster
1.plot: The end of the semester is nearing, but is Wonder Woman's Super Suit going to land her an A+?

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Weaponomics
1.plot: Wonder Woman sure knows her weaponomics, but a certain someone doesn't want her teacher to know. What happens in class will surprise you!

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Clubbing
1.plot: It's time for Poison Ivy to branch out (literally) and join some clubs. Principal's orders! But what club should she choose at Super Hero High School!?

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Hero of the Month: Bumblebee
1.plot: It's Bumblebee's time to shine for her heroic prowess, exceptional flying skills and great taste in music!! Follow along as she accepts this exciting honor from Super Hero High School!

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Saving the Day
1.plot: It's the end of the semester for Super Hero High students, but wait! A Save the Day alarm has sounded and they must fly to the rescue!

1.title: EN - DC Super Hero Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Hero of the Month: Wonder Woman
1.plot: Drum roll, please...for our Our Hero of the Month! Wonder Woman's best known for being a leader and a great friend, which is why Super Hero High nominated her!

meta.plot: Twins Dak and Leyla and their dragon friends devote their lives to rescuing others, defending their home of Huttsgalor and having fun along the way.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Nest
1.plot: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, they’re invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove they're kind and helpful.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Deep Trouble
1.plot: Dak's lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leyla's overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Boo to You
1.plot: Burple gets spooked by the legend of a ghost called the Phantom Fang. But when he senses the story is real, he can't get his friends to believe him.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Where There's Smoke
1.plot: After Magnus accuses Cutter of setting fires near the village that could hurt the sheep, the Riders have to put them out and find the real culprit.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Heavy Metal
1.plot: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Iced Out
1.plot: Frustrated that she's not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Sick Day
1.plot: When the other dragons come down with the flu, Summer must overcome her fear of eels to retrieve the cure and get her friends back in the air.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Bad Egg
1.plot: Magnus hatches a plan to hide in an egg to spy on the Rescue Riders. But things get all scrambled when a mama dragon takes him to her nest.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Home Alone
1.plot: Aggro, Burple and Cutter are left alone in the roost to care for some dragon eggs, but a trio of tricky Slinkwings want those eggs for themselves.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Slobber Power
1.plot: Cutter gets a chance to be a "mom" when a newly hatched dragon bonds with him, and they'll both be needed to get the others out of a tangled mess.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Crash Course
1.plot: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while they're with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Furious Fun
1.plot: The Rescue Riders have a "Dragon Day" to show their skills to a young fan, but Aggro skips it to hang out with her new fun -- but reckless -- friends.

1.title: EN - Dragons: Rescue Riders [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Grumblegard (1)

meta.plot: Tragedy strikes the welsh town of Glyngolau when an accident on a construction site kills a group of trespassing children. Grief quickly turns to anger and the families cry for justice. But as the gears of justice slowly turn, challenging truths begin to emerge. It falls to the Council Leader’s wife, Polly, to hold the community together, all the while also caring for a daughter – the only survivor of the collapse. meta.plot: The forest ranger's house is the only area of human civilization in the middle of untamed wilderness in a vast natural reserve in Canada. When the ranger is away, a bear named Grizzy feels that the ranger's house is his territory, given that bears sit at the top of the food chain. After making his way inside the home, Grizzy takes advantage of all the modern conveniences there, including a comfortable sofa, air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen. He's not alone, though, because a group of small creatures called lemmings also populate the ranger's house when he is away. 6.plot: Will and Geordie negotiate a complex family dispute that may be connected to the murder of the head of a local adoption agency. Meanwhile, a sinister letter arrives for Leonard.

6.title: FR - Grantchester - S06E03 - Episode 3
6.plot: Will and Geordie are drawn into local politics when the death of a councilor prompts a parish election. An allegation against Leonard rocks life at the vicarage to its core.

6.title: FR - Grantchester - S06E04 - Episode 4
6.plot: When an American airman dies in the police station, a quiet late shift turns into a challenging night for Will and Geordie. Leonard and Daniel reassess their relationship.

6.title: FR - Grantchester - S06E05 - Episode 5
6.plot: Will and Geordie investigate an audacious bank robbery, which sees Geordie unexpectedly cross paths with an old friend from his army days.

6.title: FR - Grantchester - S06E06 - Episode 6
6.plot: When the leader of a student group falls to her death during a protest, Will and Geordie are drawn into campus politics. The Bishop introduces a new face at the vicarage.

7.title: FR - Grantchester - S07E01 - Episode 1
7.plot: Will and Geordie investigate the apparent murder of Lord Edmund Fitzgerald.

7.title: FR - Grantchester - S07E02 - Episode 2
7.plot: Will and Geordie investigate when a man is found dead with an unusual neck wound.

7.title: FR - Grantchester - S07E03 - Episode 3
7.plot: A vagrant is found dead in the doorway of Leonard's cafe.

7.title: FR - Grantchester - S07E04 - Episode 4
7.plot: A member of Will's congregation is found murdered just before a church fundraising event.

7.title: FR - Grantchester - S07E05 - Episode 5
7.plot: There's a murder at a local old folks' home and two of its elderly residents go missing.

7.title: FR - Grantchester - S07E06 - Episode 6
7.plot: Geordie and Will realise that they may have sent the wrong man to prison for murder.

1.title: FR - Departure - S01E01 - Vanished
1.plot: When TransOcean Flight 716 vanishes over the Atlantic Ocean with 256 people on board, crash investigator Kendra Malley is called in.

1.title: FR - Departure - S01E02 - Survivor
1.plot: The hunt for wreckage continues as the TSIB team learn more about Donovan. Kendra wonders if the plane's lone survivor is hiding something.

1.title: FR - Departure - S01E03 - Prime Suspect
1.plot: Madelyn’s memories of the crash provide the team with a lead, and a new witness comes forward with disturbing information about Donovan.

1.title: FR - Departure - S01E04 - Sabotage
1.plot: Kendra tries to make sense of conflicting evidence and is stunned by the betrayal of someone close to her, while AJ puts his life in danger.

1.title: FR - Departure - S01E05 - Grounded
1.plot: An unlikely source has proof of a conspiracy to cover up the truth about the crash, and the team scramble to recover the black boxes.

1.title: FR - Departure - S01E06 - Endgame
1.plot: Kendra comes up with a plan to confront the Flight 716 conspirators and expose the cover up.

2.title: FR - Departure - S02E01 - Runaway
2.plot: Kendra Malley is called to the U.S. to investigate a high-speed train crash in rural Michigan.

2.title: FR - Departure - S02E02 - Fugitive
2.plot: Kendra learns about a mysterious passenger on the run after escaping from U.S. Marshals' custody.

2.title: FR - Departure - S02E03 - Walk the Line
2.plot: Kendra shares information with her FBI counterpart; Kendra gets a big break in the case.

2.title: FR - Departure - S02E04 - Wrecking Ball
2.plot: Kendra looks for connections between the victims; Max and Kendra hatch a plan with the FBI.

2.title: FR - Departure - S02E05 - Don't Tread on Me
2.plot: Kendra and Agent Hunter find proof of a larger conspiracy; a confrontation leaves Kendra shaken.

2.title: FR - Departure - S02E06 - Witness
2.plot: As the case winds down, Kendra feels there's still a missing piece of the puzzle.

3.title: FR - Departure - S03E01 - The Tempest
3.plot: A night ferry crossing suddenly goes horribly wrong. Kendra Malley and her team are called in to investigate the sinking.

3.title: FR - Departure - S03E02 - Dead in the Water
3.plot: Having found signs of life on board the sunken vessel, the race for recovery continues along with gathering of evidence. Survivors start experiencing flashbacks.

3.title: FR - Departure - S03E03 - Stowaway
3.plot: Kendra Malley and her team continue to investigate the ferry sinking. The Captain's story comes into question, when a recovered video shows a different turn of events below deck, than was first told by survivors.

3.title: FR - Departure - S03E04 - Devil and the Deep Blue Sea
3.plot: There is unexpected betrayal within the ranks, a possibly innocent man is arrested, and then a dead diver surfaces from the wreck.

3.title: FR - Departure - S03E05 - Shot Across The Bow
3.plot: A diver's mysterious identity proves to be the key to Kendra's discovery that an ally has been sabotaging her investigation from the start.

3.title: FR - Departure - S03E06 - What Lies Beneath
3.plot: Kendra and her team decides to go rogue in their quest to discover the true cause of the ferry's sinking.

meta.plot: Follow the mystery of Flight 716 - a passenger plane that vanishes over the Atlantic Ocean. Following the mysterious crash, recently widowed, brilliant aviation investigator Kendra Malley is called in to investigate by her former boss and mentor Howard Lawson.

1.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Small-time hustlers Shaïnez and Liana land in hot water with a tough Brussels drug dealer after stealing from one of his men. Anissa asks Mehdi for help.

1.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Mehdi and his men search for the missing drugs. Chris sends the Djeblis a warning. Impressed by Mehdi's skills, Saber blackmails him into taking a job.

1.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: As they gear up for a risky heist, Mehdi and Liana's gangs join forces. Hassan confronts Saber. Coralie reveals a terrible family secret to Sofia.

1.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A furious Chris prepares to wage war on the Djeblis — and everyone else involved in the heist. Hassan sends Danique to cover Saber's tracks.

1.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Mehdi tries to protect Anissa and Shaïnez. Fueled by revenge, Sofia underestimates what Chris is capable of. Liana acts carelessly.

1.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: As the war with Chris reaches a boiling point, Mehdi and Tony seek vengeance while the Djeblis plan their next move against the Antwerp enemy.

2.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: After one last heist, Mehdi arranges his affairs and prepares for Canada. The Djeblis play hardball during negotiations with new collaborators.

2.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: As Saber seeks revenge, the Los Soles cartel comes for Nahel. Commissioner Herman blackmails a captive Tony into helping her locate Mehdi.

2.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Mehdi and Saber set the terms of their new partnership. Almeida resorts to bold measures to get intel on Mehdi when the commissioner won’t budge.

2.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Faced with fresh threats after Saber goes rogue, the gang risks everything to salvage the situation. Bad news prompts Almeida to reassess his loyalty.

2.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: After Rayane's betrayal, Mehdi, Tony and Saber pursue the stolen cocaine. Liana narrowly evades danger when the cartel traces Kelly to the workshop.

2.title: FR - Braqueurs : La série - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: As the cartel war escalates, shocking losses send Liana and Mehdi reeling. Saber forges an unlikely alliance; Almeida’s game of chess comes to an end.

meta.plot: Mehdi, a qualified robber, and Liana, an apprentice thief, get involved in a turf war between drug dealers, and have to collaborate in order to save their loved ones.
Sea animal friends Bruda, Bobbi, Wayu and Puri go on mini adventures in the ocean, where relatable, everyday moments come with a splash of magic.

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Bruda's Pie
1.plot: At the school picnic, the friends follow their noses to a perfectly baked plankton pie that Bruda made with his mom. Good thing he's got enough to share!

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Bobbi's Tooth
1.plot: Bobbi's lost his wiggly tooth, and it's fallen into the Ticklish Reef. Can his ocean friends help him find it? Yes, they can — with a side of giggles!

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Playhouse
1.plot: While his pals are playing nearby, Puri befriends a baby sea spider! The others are scared at first, but they soon learn there's nothing to be afraid of.

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Uncle Tao
1.plot: Wayu saw something strange while playing ball near the school, but her friends don't believe her — until a game of peekaboo opens everyone's eyes!

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Volcano Lunch
1.plot: Bruda's making lunch for his mom but needs Wayu's help when he doesn't have all the ingredients. It's the nicest — and spiciest — meal Mom's ever had!

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Jellyfish Bus
1.plot: Bobbi is usually bold, but he's nervous about trying something new: taking a field trip on a special squishy bus! All he needs is a little encouragement.

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Wayu and the Coral
1.plot: Shhh! The kids must stay quiet and patient while they wait for the rare rainbow coral to bloom. After all, it only happens once in a blue moon!

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Fluffy Rock
1.plot: Puri finds a rock that's furry — with a fluffy tail and two long ears! But it's actually an unusual animal who's eager to make art with new friends.

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Bruda's Pop-up Book
1.plot: Bruda's so proud of the pop-up book he made with his mom... so it's especially hard for Bobbi to find the courage to admit that he broke it.

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Digging for Treasure
1.plot: Puri leaves his tidy home to play at Wayu's house, where she lives with her grandparents, cousins, uncles and aunts — and the rules are really different!

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Hide and Seek
1.plot: Bruda's size works against him in hide-and-seek, so he's got to be extra creative. He just needs to find the right hiding place!

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Bobbi in Bed
1.plot: The kids figure out a way to play a game together, even though Bobbi's sick in bed. Now he's just got to stay calm so he can pay attention to the clues!

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Photo Day
1.plot: Wayu's trying to stay neat and clean on school picture day, and it's getting in the way of having fun! But a great smile is all that really matters.

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Color Dancing
1.plot: Each of the kids brings a crayon to school, and Miss Aim encourages them to get their colors "talking." The end result is art that's lovely to look at.

1.title: EN - Sea of Love [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - The Littlest Gift
1.plot: Everyone brings gifts to school to honor Miss Aim on Teacher's Day. Bruda's worried that his isn't big enough — but it came from the heart.

meta.plot: Curious kid Ridley and her friends protect the Museum of Natural History’s treasures and keep its magical secret safe: Everything comes alive at night!

1.title: EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Ready or Not, Here I Com
1.plot: A special necklace has gone missing, and if Ridley can't find it, her mom could lose her job!

1.title: EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Some Like It Hot
1.plot: Ridley must rescue a pint-sized penguin from the desert.

1.title: EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Fly Like an Eagle
1.plot: Dudley the dodo causes a museum mix-up when he switches exhibits.

1.title: EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - My Dinner with Ismat
1.plot: Egyptian queen Ismat wants to hide her family's royal routine from her friends.

1.title: EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Un-Fit for a Queen
1.plot: Ismat shares a secret with Ridley and Fred the bison during a sleepover.

1.title: EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Peaches, We Have a Problem
1.plot: Space monkey Peaches must help her friends avoid the new security system.

2.title: EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Bison Ball
EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Dude, Where's Our Egg?
EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Northern Lights
EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Slow Place Like Home
EN - Ridley Jones [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - A Stamp for Mama

meta.plot: Two siblings - an idealistic teenage boy and his naïve younger sister - are forced to pilot an abandoned Jaeger across a hostile landscape in a desperate attempt to find their missing parents.

1.title: EN - Pacific Rim: The Black [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - From the Shadows
1.plot: Five years after their parents left to find help, siblings Taylor and Hayley find a training Jaeger - but it quickly attracts a Kaiju to their village.

1.title: EN - Pacific Rim: The Black [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Into the Black
1.plot: When Atlas Destroyer runs out of energy, Taylor and Hayley search a nearby destroyed city for power cells and make some startling discoveries.

1.title: EN - Pacific Rim: The Black [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Bogan
1.plot: While on foot, Taylor, Hayley and Boy encounter a mobile settlement that traffics in Kaiju body parts.  Its shady leader seeks to uncover their secret.

1.title: EN - Pacific Rim: The Black [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Up and Running
1.plot: When a Kaiju fast approaches, Shane forces Taylor to copilot Atlas Destroyer with Mei to get it out of harm's way, but Taylor wants to fight.

1.title: EN - Pacific Rim: The Black [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Escaping Bogan
1.plot: To take back Atlas Destroyer and save Hayley and Boy, Taylor attempts a risky maneuverer known as "ghost piloting."  Joel and Mei make a deadly choice.

1.title: EN - Pacific Rim: The Black [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Boneyard
1.plot: The mystery behind Boy's past deepens when Taylor and Hayley find him among dead Kaiju and destroyed Jaegers - along with the creature responsible.

1.title: EN - Pacific Rim: The Black [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Showdown
1.plot: While responding to a distress signal, Taylor and Hayley find their parents' abandoned Jaeger and confront the Kaiju that attacked their village.

meta.plot: When Adam, Prince of the planet Eternia, raises his magic sword he transforms into He-Man (the most powerful man in the universe).  With his allies and friends, he battles the evil Skeletor and his minions to protect the secrets of Castle Greyskull.

1.title: EN - He-Man and the Masters of the Universe [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Diamond Ray of Disappearance
1.plot: Skeletor has managed to find the legendary 'Diamond Ray Of Disappearance', a mystical jewel that sends who or whatever it is aimed at vanishing into another dimension. Calling his warriors from around the Universe, Skeletor plans to use the magical gem to get rid of He-Man once-and-for-all. His first victims are King Randor, Queen Marlena, and Man-At-Arms, as well as The Sorceress of Grayskull, and it is up to He-Man to destroy the jewel, freeing his friends from the distant limbo-like dimension that they are trapped in...

1.title: EN - He-Man and the Masters of the Universe [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Teela's Quest
1.plot:
After Queen Marlena, using Man-At-Arm's new 'mind projector', relives how she came to crash-land on Eternia years before, Teela tries to use the device to learn who her mother is, but is frustrated when it is unable to display the image. She decides to head to the Crysal Sea, in search of the legendary Oracle, the only thing on Eternia that could possibly tell her of her true parents.

But Mer-Man, defeated years before by Man-At-Arms, is looking to get even, and plans to use Teela as a sacrifice to a sea God...

1.title: EN - He-Man and the Masters of the Universe [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Colossor Awakes
1.plot: Skeletor's latest invention, the Collector, is capable of bringing stone statues to life and turning people to stone. With Beast Man, he attacks the Royal Palace with the new device, bringing court-yard statues to life and freezing Man-At-Arms in stone. If the effect isn't reversed by sundown, he will be cast in stone forever. As He-Man, advised by The Sorceress, goes to search for the one thing that can aid them in reversing the spell, Skeletor uses the energy the Collector has taken from his victims to awaken an ancient, giant statue, and turns it on Castle Grayskull...

1.title: EN - He-Man and the Masters of the Universe [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Dragon Invasion
1.plot: Skeletor and Beast Man steal a dragon's eggs and transport them into the court-yard of the Royal Palace. With their special growth enhancer, the dragons soon hatch and grow, attacking the Palace, and leaving the Heroic Warriors distracted trying to deal with the ever-growing dragons leaving Skeletor and his cronies free tackle Castle Grayskull...

1.title: EN - He-Man and the Masters of the Universe [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Curse of the Spellstone
1.plot: Skeletor and Evil-Lyn break into the temple of the Fire People and steal the Spellstone, with which they unleash a terrible storm. While He-Man, with Ram Man, Stratos and Battle Cat, goes off to try and retrieve the Spellstone, Evil-Lyn magically disguises herself as an old lady, and convinces Eternia's peasants that the storm was a result of the Elders being angry at the Royal family. She soon convinces them to unleash the Creeping Horac - an ever-growing weed-like entity that covers buildings and gradually sucks away the air - onto the Royal Palace...

meta.plot: With the casualties of war still haunting him, young Levius uses his prosthetic arm to take his fight into the brutal world of Mecha Boxing.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - All of the impact ends up here
1.plot: Against his trainer's wishes, Levius uses his spin hook on his opponent. Despite the risk of mechanical failure, he wants to keep using it.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Does it seem like the boy is getting on okay?
1.plot: Levius's uncle Zack takes him in after his mother is injured during the war. They struggle to connect until Levius shows an interest in boxing.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - How in the world does that thing pass as an elbow guard?
1.plot: Malcolm Eden's last five bouts have all ended in his opponent's death. Zack pleads with Levius to forfeit the upcoming fight, but Levius refuses.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - He… He's the real thing…
1.plot: Levius is somehow unable to dodge Eden's punches. Natalia and Zack figure out what's going on just in time for the maintenance break.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Do I look like an idiot who thinks about losing before a fight?
1.plot: The hulking Hugo Stratus is Levius's opponent in his promotion bout. While Natalia is upset at being passed over, Bill is suspicious.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - She called out for my help
1.plot: Levius recognizes the mark on AJ's armor, and remembers where he's seen it before. Hugo's father urges him to forfeit the match, but he's too proud.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Do you remember? We met before
1.plot: The group visits Clown's residence. When Levius asks AJ if she recalls their first meeting, she insists he's misremembering the events in Greenbridge.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - These young geniuses… It's enough to make you sick…
1.plot: Team Levius prepares for the next fight: Bill fabricates a new arm, while Zack and Natalia help Levius train. Malcolm Eden volunteers to assist.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Can you make the deadline?
1.plot: Levius's new arm fails the first inspection. When Bill's frantic fixes don't solve the issue, Levius proposes a radical and life-threatening solution.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - It's me who's to give you that thrashing!
1.plot: The fight with AJ begins, with both their futures on the line. AJ's inhuman movement and inability to feel pain make her a formidable foe.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The possiblility of it working is infinitely close to zero!
1.plot: The stratagem fails, and AJ returns to the ring. Team Levius realizes she's cheating, but only Zack's desperate choice can stop her in time.

1.title: EN - Levius [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - It's finer than usual today
1.plot: Levius has just one spin hook left; AJ's second steam engine is just below her heart. It may not be possible to both win the fight and save her life.

meta.plot: A sheltered girl gets a crash course in survival when a mutant attack sends her to the surface, far from the safety of her underground home.

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Burrow Girl
1.plot: Swept from her safe burrow, Kipo emerges in a wild surface world full of weird mutant animals. Will her new friends Wolf and Mandu help her get home?

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Explosion Berries
1.plot: Benson gets a jump on the Mod Frogs to save Kipo, Wolf and his little buddy Dave. But it'll take a hopping mad Mega Bunny to get them out of another jam.

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Real Cats Wear Plaid
1.plot: Held captive by the brawling Timbercats, Kipo and pals must find the tough kitties’ leader, Yumyan Hammerpaw, if they want to avoid becoming cat food.

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Cactus Town
1.plot: Leading an army of new allies, Kipo argues with Wolf about the best way to avoid a hissy fit on Umlaut Snäke turf. Can she talk it out with a Mega Mute?

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Astronomers in Turtlenecks
1.plot: Kipo and the gang act like a pack to cozy up to the nerdy Newton Wolves and use their telescope to find the burrow people. The hunt is on.

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Ratland
1.plot: The wolves break the news to Scarlemagne as Kipo tries to crack her father’s code. Then Benson gives the burrow girl a 13th birthday surprise -- or two.

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Mulholland
1.plot: The friends stumble upon tardigrade dream-maker Tad Mulholland, who allows the gang to realize their bliss. But let's get real: It comes at a price.

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Twin Beaks
1.plot: Scarlemagne rallies his troops as Kipo searches for her next clue, which sends her into a trash canyon -- and into a hideaway for Fitness Raccoons.

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Mute-Eat-Mute World
1.plot: A big secret’s out, and Wolf can’t deal. Meanwhile, Kipo must resist the urge to pet Mega Bunny babies before escaping from sticky Mod Frog Jamack.

1.title: EN - Kipo and the Age of Wonderbeasts [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Beyond the Valley of the Dogs
1.plot: It’s a high-jumping, thirsty Mega Flea vs. the Mega Dogs as Kipo closes in on the burrow. But has she also brought home disaster?

meta.plot: A boy's superhero dreams come true when he finds five powerful cosmic stones. But saving the day is harder than he imagined — and he can't do it alone.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Kid Cosmic and the Rings of Power!
1.plot: After Kid discovers five powerful cosmic stones, he turns to teen waitress Jo for help in figuring them out — and keeping them out of the wrong hands.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Kid Cosmic y la Niña Gigantica
1.plot: When 4-year-old Rosa transforms into a 40-foot giant after finding one of the rings, it's up to Kid and Jo to keep the destructive tot out of trouble.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Kid Cosmic and the Precognitive Cat
1.plot: Sensing danger, newly superpowered cat Tuna Sandwich sets off on a quest to save Kid, whose attempt to lead a team mission goes all kinds of wrong.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Kid Cosmic and the Local Heroes
1.plot: As Kid and the self-proclaimed Local Heroes confront a wave of alien invaders, everyone starts to get the hang of their powers. Well, almost everyone.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Kid Cosmic and the Big Win
1.plot: Kid and the Local Heroes try to protect their family, friends and favorite place to eat when a pack of demonic alien dogs invades the diner.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Kid Cosmic and the Epic Fail
1.plot: Pushed to the edge by Chuck’s nonstop taunts, Kid decides to steal the other four rings and go it alone in a desert showdown with Chuck's Great Leader.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Kid Cosmic and the Invaders from Earth
1.plot: When the mysterious man in black and his army take over the town, Tuna Sandwich partners with a former foe in order to bring the team back together.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Earth Force Enforcement Force
1.plot: While an elite new squad of government-sponsored superheroes faces down an alien threat, Kid begins to wonder if he's misjudged the entire situation.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Kid Cosmic and the Bad Good Guys
1.plot: Kid may be down, but he's definitely not out. With a wild plan in place, he and the Local Heroes suit up and race into danger to stop the alien battle.

1.title: EN - Kid Cosmic [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Kid Cosmic and the Day is Saved!
1.plot: Things aren't looking good for the team, but that won't stop Kid from trying to save the day as he finally learns what being a real hero is all about.

meta.plot: Young Johnny is gung-ho and full of courage. Johnny's brainiac twin sisters, Susan and Mary, use Johnny as their guinea pig for their outrageous scientific experiments. If they can dream it up, Johnny will do it; as long as his genetically engineered super dog, Dukey, can come along.

1.title: EN - Johnny Test [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Johnny to the Center of the Earth
1.plot: Things have been mysteriously disappearing underground, making Johnny and Dukey believe that the people behind this are "mole people". When Johnny accidentally loses his dad's new camera, he must journey to the center of the earth to retrieve it before dinnertime, or he will be grounded.

1.title: EN - Johnny Test [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Johnny X
1.plot: Susan and Mary give Gil a piece of their special love "bubble gum", but by accident, it makes him transform. In order to save Gil and the others in pork belly, they have to give Johnny and Dukey some cool super powers.

1.title: EN - Johnny Test [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Johnny vs. Bling-Bling Boy
1.plot: Bling-Bling Boy has stolen a device that turns things into gold and Johnny must get it back before dinnertime.

1.title: EN - Johnny Test [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Johnny Impossible
